response: {"headword":"aboard","explanation":"「aboard」通常用於描述進入或在交通工具（尤其是船、飛機、火車）上的狀態。在學測閱讀中，它常出現在旅程、旅行或團隊合作的情境中。要注意它既可作為介系詞（後接受詞）也可作為副詞（單獨使用）。","senses":[{"sense":"在（船、飛機、火車）上；登機/船/車","entries":[{"pattern":"aboard the ...","pos":"preposition","translation":"在…上","explanation":"直接接交通工具作為受詞，表示在該交通工具內部的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After checking their tickets, the passengers were finally allowed to step <target>aboard</target> <pattern>the</pattern> giant cruise ship for their summer vacation.","translation":"在檢查票券後，乘客們終於被允許登上帝國巨大的郵輪，展開他們的夏季假期。"},{"sentence":"The flight attendant welcomed everyone <target>aboard</target> <pattern>the</pattern> plane and asked them to fasten their seatbelts before takeoff.","translation":"空服員歡迎每個人登機，並要求他們在起飛前繫好安全帶。"}]},{"pattern":"go / come aboard","pos":"phrase","translation":"登船/機/車；加入（團隊或公司）","explanation":"除了物理上的登機，在商務或團隊情境中，常用於比喻指加入一個新團隊或公司。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Once the captain gave the signal, the sailors quickly <target>went</target> <pattern>aboard</pattern> to prepare the ship for the long voyage.","translation":"一旦船長發出信號，水手們迅速登船，為漫長的航程做準備。"},{"sentence":"We are thrilled to have such a talented young designer <target>come</target> <pattern>aboard</pattern> our creative marketing team this month.","translation":"我們非常高興這個月能有如此才華橫溢的年輕設計師加入我們的創意行銷團隊。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"on board","pos":"phrase","translation":"在船/機/車上","explanation":"與 aboard 同義，但 on board 更常在口語中使用。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"由 a- (to/on) 與 board (甲板/木板) 組成，原指在船的甲板上。","related":[{"word":"board","pos":"noun","translation":"甲板；董事會","explanation":"原指船的甲板，後來延伸至指代一個決策團體（董事會）。"}]}}

{"headword":"acceptable","explanation":"「acceptable」在學測中常出現在討論社會規範、行為準則或產品品質的語境中。其核心含義是「可接受的」，通常指達到最低限度的標準或符合要求，而非指「最好」的。","senses":[{"sense":"可接受的；符合標準的","entries":[{"pattern":"be acceptable to sb.","pos":"phrase","translation":"對某人來說是可以接受的","explanation":"常用於表達對某項提議、條件或決定之認可。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company offered a new contract, but the salary increase was not <target>acceptable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the workers who wanted more money.","translation":"公司提供了一份新合約，但對那些想要更多錢的工人來說，薪水漲幅是不可接受的。"},{"sentence":"If the weather is too rainy, moving the school sports day to next Friday might be <target>acceptable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> most students.","translation":"如果雨水太多，將學校運動會移至下週五對大多數學生來說可能是可以接受的。"}]},{"pattern":"socially acceptable","pos":"phrase","translation":"社會上可接受的","explanation":"固定搭配，常用於討論文化差異或社會行為準則。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In some cultures, it is not <target>acceptable</target> to speak loudly in a public library, as it is seen as very rude.","translation":"在某些文化中，在公共圖書館大聲說話是不被接受的，因為這被視為非常沒禮貌。"},{"sentence":"Wearing casual clothes to a formal wedding is often not <target>acceptable</target> in traditional societies where dress codes are very strict.","translation":"在傳統社會中，穿著便服參加正式婚禮通常是不被接受的，因為那裡的服裝規定非常嚴格。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"satisfactory","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人滿意的；合格的","explanation":"強調達到最低要求或標準。"},{"word":"tolerable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可忍受的","explanation":"強調在可承受範圍內。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unacceptable","pos":"adjective","translation":"不可接受的","explanation":"直接對立面。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 accept (接受) + 形容詞字尾 -able (可…的)","related":[{"word":"accept","pos":"verb","translation":"接受","explanation":"核心動詞。"},{"word":"acceptance","pos":"noun","translation":"接受；認可","explanation":"由 accept 加上名詞字尾 -ance 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"accurate","explanation":"「accurate」的核心含義是「精確的」，在學測中常出現在科學實驗、數據分析、翻譯或新聞報導的語境中。要注意它與 precise 的區別：accurate 指的是「正確地對準目標」，而 precise 指的是 點位精確到細節。","senses":[{"sense":"精確的；正確的","entries":[{"pattern":"accurate information / data","pos":"phrase","translation":"精確的資訊/數據","explanation":"強搭配，常用於描述科學研究或新聞報導的真實性。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The scientist spent three years gathering <target>accurate</target> <pattern>data</pattern> to prove that the global temperature is rising every year.","translation":"這位科學家花了三年時間收集精確的數據，以證明全球溫度每年都在上升。"},{"sentence":"Because the old map was not <target>accurate</target>, the hikers got lost in the deep forest for two whole days.","translation":"因為那張舊地圖不精確，登山客在深林中迷路了整整兩天。"}]},{"pattern":"be accurate in sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"在…方面很精確","explanation":"描述某人在處理細節或記錄時的精準度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The accountant must be extremely <target>accurate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> calculating the company's yearly taxes to avoid any legal problems.","translation":"會計師在計算公司的年度稅金時必須極其精確，以避免任何法律問題。"},{"sentence":"The witness was very <target>accurate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> describing the thief's face, which helped the police catch the criminal quickly.","translation":"證人對小偷臉部的描述非常精確，這幫助警方迅速抓獲了罪犯。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"precise","pos":"adjective","translation":"精確的","explanation":"強調細節的極度精準。"},{"word":"exact","pos":"adjective","translation":"確切的","explanation":"強調與原物完全一致。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"inaccurate","pos":"adjective","translation":"不正確的","explanation":"直接對立面。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 accur (care/正確) + 形容詞字尾 -ate","related":[{"word":"accuracy","pos":"noun","translation":"精確度","explanation":"由 accurate 加上名詞字尾 -cy 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"ache","explanation":"「ache」指一種持續性的、隱隱作痛的感覺。在學測中，常出現在健康、醫療或壓力管理（如：心痛、肌肉酸痛）的語境中。要注意它既可作為名詞（疼痛）也可作為動詞（渴望）。","senses":[{"sense":"疼痛；隱隱作痛 (名詞/動詞)","entries":[{"pattern":"stomach ache / headache / back ache","pos":"phrase","translation":"胃痛 / 頭痛 / 背痛","explanation":"常見的複合名詞搭配，指身體特定部位的持續性疼痛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After eating too many spicy snacks at the night market, the young girl started to feel a terrible <target>stomach</target> <pattern>ache</pattern>.","translation":"在夜市吃了太多辛辣零食後，那個小女孩開始感到嚴重的胃痛。"},{"sentence":"The student had a severe <target>headache</target> because he stayed up late every night to study for the final exams.","translation":"這名學生因為每晚熬夜準備期末考而感到劇烈的頭痛。"}]},{"pattern":"ache from sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"因為…而疼痛","explanation":"描述疼痛的來源或原因。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My muscles began to <target>ache</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the heavy exercise I did at the gym yesterday afternoon.","translation":"因為昨天下午在健身房做的劇烈運動，我的肌肉開始感到酸痛。"},{"sentence":"Her legs <target>ached</target> <pattern>from</pattern> walking for five hours to explore the ancient temple in the mountains.","translation":"因為在山中探索古廟走了五個小時，她的腿感到酸痛。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"pain","pos":"noun","translation":"疼痛","explanation":"泛指各類疼痛，比 ache 劇烈。"},{"word":"sore","pos":"adjective","translation":"疼痛的；酸痛的","explanation":"常用於肌肉酸痛或喉嚨痛。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"ached","past_participle":"ached"},"relatives":{"morphology":"單一字根，指身體的疼痛感。","related":[]}}

{"headword":"achieve","explanation":"「achieve」在學測中是極高頻的動詞，常用於描述目標、成功、夢想或結果。核心含義是「透過努力地達成」。要注意它與 attain 或 accomplish 之間的細微區別，其受詞通常是抽象的成功或目標。","senses":[{"sense":"達成；實現（目標、夢想、成功）","entries":[{"pattern":"achieve a goal / dream / success","pos":"phrase","translation":"達成目標 / 實現夢想 / 取得成功","explanation":"強搭配，指透過努力地獲得某種成就。","sentences":[{"sentence":"With hard work and a positive attitude, you can <target>achieve</target> <pattern>your</pattern> goal of becoming a professional doctor.","translation":"只要有努力和積極的態度，你就能實現成為一名專業醫師的目標。"},{"sentence":"After years of training in the cold mountains, the climber finally <target>achieved</target> <pattern>his</pattern> dream of reaching the top.","translation":"經過在寒冷山脈中多年的訓練，登山者終於實現了登頂的夢想。"}]},{"pattern":"achieve sth. through sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"透過…達成某事","explanation":"常用於論述文，描述達成成功的路徑或路徑。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students <target>achieve</target> better grades <pattern>through</pattern> better time management and a strict study plan.","translation":"許多學生透過更好的時間管理和嚴格的學習計畫來取得更好的成績。"},{"sentence":"The government <target>achieved</target> a reduction in pollution <pattern>through</pattern> new laws that limit the use of plastic bags.","translation":"政府透過限制使用塑膠袋的新法律，達成了減少污染的目標。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"accomplish","pos":"verb","translation":"完成；達成","explanation":"強調完成一項任務或目標。"},{"word":"attain","pos":"verb","translation":"達到；獲得","explanation":"強調到達某個特定水平或狀態。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"fail","pos":"verb","translation":"失敗","explanation":" "}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"achieved","past_participle":"achieved"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 achieve (達成) + 各類字尾","related":[{"word":"achievement","pos":"noun","translation":"成就；達成","explanation":"由 achieve 加上名詞字尾 -ment 延伸而來。"},{"word":"achievable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可達成的","explanation":" "}]}}

{"headword":"additional","explanation":"「additional」在學測中常用於描述數量、成本或資訊的增加。重點在於它與 added 的區別：additional 強調的是「額外補充」而非單純的「增加」。","senses":[{"sense":"額外的；補充的","entries":[{"pattern":"additional information / details","pos":"phrase","translation":"額外資訊／詳情","explanation":"常用於信件或學術論文中，用來指補充說明以使內容更完整。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you need <target>additional</target> <pattern>information</pattern> about the college application process, please feel free to contact the admissions office.","translation":"如果您需要關於大學申請程序的額外資訊，請隨時與招生辦公室聯繫。"},{"sentence":"The detective asked the witness for <target>additional</target> <pattern>details</pattern> about the suspect's clothing to help identify the man more accurately.","translation":"偵探要求證人提供關於嫌疑人衣著的額外詳情，以幫助更準確地辨識該男子。"}]},{"pattern":"additional cost / fee","pos":"phrase","translation":"額外費用","explanation":"在消費或服務情境中，指在基本價格之外需要支付的款項。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hotel room is quite cheap, but you will have to pay an <target>additional</target> <pattern>cost</pattern> if you want breakfast included.","translation":"這間飯店房間相當便宜，但如果您想要包含早餐，您必須支付額外費用。"},{"sentence":"Many airlines charge an <target>additional</target> <pattern>fee</pattern> for passengers who bring too many heavy bags on the plane.","translation":"許多航空公司會對攜帶過多重型行李的乘客收取額外費用。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"extra","pos":"adjective","translation":"額外的；多餘的","explanation":"最通用且口語的詞彙，指超出需求或標準的數量。"},{"word":"supplementary","pos":"adjective","translation":"補充的","explanation":"較為正式，強調為了填補不足而提供的補充。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"insufficient","pos":"adjective","translation":"不足的","explanation":"指數量或品質未達到最低要求。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 add (增加) + 形容詞字尾 -itional","related":[{"word":"add","pos":"verb","translation":"增加；加上","explanation":"最基礎的動詞形式。"},{"word":"addition","pos":"noun","translation":"增加；加法","explanation":"由 add 延伸而來的名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"admire","explanation":"「admire」在學測中常用於描述對某人的才華、勇氣或自然美景的讚賞。注意它與 appreciate 的區別：admire 更強調「崇拜」或「欣賞」某物之美。","senses":[{"sense":"欽佩；欣賞","entries":[{"pattern":"admire sb. for sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"因某事而欽佩某人","explanation":"這是最常見的搭配，用來具體說明欽佩的理由。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many young students <target>admire</target> the famous scientist <pattern>for</pattern> her courage to challenge old ideas and find new truths.","translation":"許多年輕學生因那位著名科學家挑戰舊觀念並發現新真理的勇氣而欽佩她。"},{"sentence":"I truly <target>admire</target> my father <pattern>for</pattern> his hard work and dedication to providing a better life for our whole family.","translation":"我真的很欽佩我父親為了給我們全家提供更好生活而付出的努力與奉獻。"}]},{"pattern":"admire sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"欣賞某物","explanation":"指對藝術品、風景或某人的外貌、成就做出正面評價。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tourists stopped for a while to <target>admire</target> the beautiful sunset over the ocean, which painted the sky in orange and purple.","translation":"遊客們停下來一會兒，欣賞海面上美麗的日落，將天空染成了橙色與紫色。"},{"sentence":"We spent the entire afternoon in the museum, <target>admiring</target> the detailed paintings of the great artists from the past.","translation":"我們花了一整個下午在博物館裡，欣賞古代偉大藝術家的細膩畫作。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"respect","pos":"verb","translation":"尊敬；尊重","explanation":"強調對某人的地位、權威或人格的尊重。"},{"word":"esteem","pos":"verb","translation":"尊重；敬重","explanation":"較為正式，指對某人的價值或品質的高評價。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"despise","pos":"verb","translation":"鄙視；輕視","explanation":"指對某人或某物感到厭惡且認為其毫無價值。"},{"word":"scorn","pos":"verb","translation":"蔑視","explanation":"指公開地表示不屑。"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"admired","past_participle":"admired"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 admir (驚訝、欽佩) + 動詞字尾 -e","related":[{"word":"admiration","pos":"noun","translation":"欽佩；讚賞","explanation":"由動詞 admire 加上名詞字尾 -tion 延伸而來。"},{"word":"admirable","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人欽佩的","explanation":"由動詞 admire 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"advanced","explanation":"「advanced」在學測中具有兩種核心語意：一是描述技術、設備或知識的「進階」或「先進」；二是描述學習者或學習階段的「高級」。","senses":[{"sense":"先進的；高級的（技術、知識、階段）","entries":[{"pattern":"advanced technology / systems","pos":"phrase","translation":"先進技術／系統","explanation":"常用於科技論文或環境科學文章中，描述最前沿的發展。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new hospital uses <target>advanced</target> <pattern>technology</pattern> to find diseases early, which helps doctors save more lives every year.","translation":"這家新醫院使用先進技術來早期發現疾病，這有助於醫生每年救更多人的生命。"},{"sentence":"To protect the environment, scientists are developing <target>advanced</target> <pattern>systems</pattern> to clean the plastic waste from the ocean.","translation":"為了保護環境，科學家正在開發先進系統來清除海洋中的塑料廢物。"}]},{"pattern":"advanced level / course","pos":"phrase","translation":"高級程度／課程","explanation":"指學習進度較快或內容更深奧的階段。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she is very good at English, the teacher suggested that she take an <target>advanced</target> <pattern>course</pattern> next semester.","translation":"因為她的英文非常好，所以老師建議她下學期修一門高級課程。"},{"sentence":"Only students with <target>advanced</target> <pattern>knowledge</pattern> of history can understand the complex reasons why the ancient war started.","translation":"只有具備歷史高級知識的學生才能理解古代戰爭爆發的複雜原因。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sophisticated","pos":"adjective","translation":"複雜且先進的","explanation":"強調技術的高端與複雜度。"},{"word":"modern","pos":"adjective","translation":"現代的","explanation":"較通用，指當前時代的技術。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"primitive","pos":"adjective","translation":"原始的","explanation":"指最基礎、未經開發的技術或方式。"},{"word":"basic","pos":"adjective","translation":"基礎的","explanation":"指最起步的學習階段。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 advance (前進) + 過去分詞字尾 -ed","related":[{"word":"advance","pos":"verb","translation":"前進；推進","explanation":"基礎動詞形式。"},{"word":"advantage","pos":"noun","translation":"優勢；利益","explanation":"同根詞，指前進時所擁有的有利條件。"}]}}

{"headword":"advantage","explanation":"「advantage」在學測中常出現在對比分析文章中，用來描述某種選擇或特質的「優點」或「優勢」。需注意其搭配的介系詞 for 和 of。","senses":[{"sense":"優勢；優點（比起他人或他物更有利的條件）","entries":[{"pattern":"take advantage of sth./sb.","pos":"phrase","translation":"利用某事／利用某人","explanation":"可用於正面（利用機會）或負面（利用他人）的語境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"You should <target>take advantage of</target> the free library books <pattern>of</pattern> your school to improve your reading skills.","translation":"你應該利用學校的免費圖書館書籍來提高你的閱讀能力。"},{"sentence":"The dishonest salesman tried to <target>take advantage of</target> the old man <pattern>of</pattern> his lack of knowledge about cars.","translation":"那個不誠實的銷售員試圖利用老人對汽車知識的缺乏來佔其便宜。"}]},{"pattern":"have an advantage over sth./sb.","pos":"phrase","translation":"比…具有優勢","explanation":"用於對比兩者之間，強調其中一方更有利。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she grew up in London, she has a great <target>advantage</target> <pattern>over</pattern> other students in the English speaking competition.","translation":"因為她在倫敦長大，她在英文口說比賽中比其他學生具有極大優勢。"},{"sentence":"Electric cars have a clear <target>advantage</target> <pattern>over</pattern> traditional gas cars because they do not produce harmful smoke.","translation":"電動車比傳統燃油車具有明顯優勢，因為它們不產生有害煙霧。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"benefit","pos":"noun","translation":"利益；好處","explanation":"泛指任何對人有益的事物。"},{"word":"edge","pos":"noun","translation":"優勢","explanation":"指在競爭中僅僅一點點的領先地位。"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"disadvantage","pos":"noun","translation":"劣勢；缺點","explanation":"直接的反義詞，指不利的條件。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 advant (前進) + 名詞字尾 -age","related":[{"word":"advantageous","pos":"adjective","translation":"有利的","explanation":"由名詞 advantage 加上形容詞字尾 -ous 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"adventure","explanation":"「adventure」在學測中常用於描述探索、旅行或生命中不平凡的經驗。它通常與 explore 或 experience 搭配。","senses":[{"sense":"冒險；刺激的經驗","entries":[{"pattern":"go on an adventure","pos":"phrase","translation":"去冒險","explanation":"常用於描述旅行或探索未知領域的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After graduating from high school, the two friends decided to <target>go on an adventure</target> to the rainforests of Brazil.","translation":"高中畢業後，這兩個朋友決定去巴西的雨林冒險。"},{"sentence":"The young boy dreamed of <target>going on an adventure</target> to find the hidden treasure in the deep, dark mountains.","translation":"這個小男孩夢想著去深山中尋找隱藏寶藏的冒險。"}]},{"pattern":"seek adventure","pos":"verb","translation":"尋求冒險","explanation":"指主動地尋找刺激或不尋常的經驗。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many young people leave their small towns to <target>seek adventure</target> in big cities where they can meet different people.","translation":"許多年輕人離開他們的小鎮，前往大城市尋求冒險，在那裡他們可以結識不同的人。"},{"sentence":"The explorer spent his whole life <target>seeking adventure</target> in the coldest parts of the world, such as Antarctica.","translation":"這位探險家花了一輩子在世界最寒冷的地方（如南極洲）尋求冒險。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"exploration","pos":"noun","translation":"探索","explanation":"指對未知領域的進行系統性的地圖化或研究。"},{"word":"experience","pos":"noun","translation":"經驗；體驗","explanation":"explanation\": "}],"antonyms":[{"word":"safety","pos":"noun","translation":"安全","explanation":"指處於無風險的狀態。"},{"word":"routine","pos":"noun","translation":"常規；例行公事","explanation":"指每天重複且無趣的日常生活。"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 advent (來到) + 名詞字尾 -ure","related":[{"word":"advent","pos":"noun","translation":"出現；到來","explanation":" "}]}}

{"headword":"advise","explanation":"「advise」在學測中常作為建議建議類文章的關鍵字。最核心的用法是 advise sb. to do sth. 或 advise doing sth.，學生必須區分 distinguish a-d-v-i-s-e (動詞) 與 a-d-v-i-c-e (名詞) 的拼寫與發音差異。","senses":[{"sense":"建議；提供忠告","entries":[{"pattern":"advise sb. to do sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"建議某人做某事","explanation":"最常見的用法，後接受詞加上不定詞 (to V)。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My high school teacher <target>advised</target> <pattern>me</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> read more English books to improve my vocabulary and reading speed.","translation":"我的高中老師建議我多讀英文書，以提高我的詞彙量和閱讀速度。"},{"sentence":"The doctor <target>advised</target> <pattern>the patient</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> stop smoking immediately if he wanted to avoid serious lung disease.","translation":"醫生建議病人立即戒菸，如果他想要避免嚴重的肺病。"}]},{"pattern":"advise against doing sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"建議不要做某事","explanation":"against 是介系詞，因此後面接動名詞 (V-ing)。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the mountain path was very slippery, the guide <target>advised</target> <pattern>against</pattern> <pattern>hiking</pattern> up the mountain during the rain.","translation":"因為山路非常濕滑，導遊建議不要在雨天登山。"}]},{"pattern":"advise that... (should)","pos":"phrase","translation":"建議…（後接 that 子句）","explanation":"在 that 子句中，動詞常用原形動詞，因為隱含了 should 的意思（假設語氣）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The financial expert <target>advised</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the government <pattern>should</pattern> lower taxes to help small businesses grow.","translation":"財務專家建議政府應該降低稅金，以幫助小企業成長。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"通知；告知","entries":[{"pattern":"advise sb. of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"通知某人某事","explanation":"較為正式的用法，常用於商務書信或正式通知。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Please <target>advise</target> <pattern>us</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> any changes to the flight schedule as soon as possible.","translation":"請盡快通知我們航班時間表的任何變更。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"advised","past_participle":"advised"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 vis (看) + 字尾 -ise (使...成為)","related":[{"word":"advice","pos":"noun","translation":"建議；忠告","explanation":"不可數名詞，學測常考其不可數特性。"},{"word":"advisable","pos":"adjective","translation":"明智的；可建議的","explanation":"由 advise 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來。"},{"word":"advisor","pos":"noun","translation":"顧問","explanation":"指提供建議的人。"}]}}

{"headword":"advisor","explanation":"「advisor」 (或 advisor) 在學測中常出現在教育、職涯規劃或政府政策討論中。它是一個簡單的名詞，指提供專業建議的人，重點在於其搭配詞與上下文語境。","senses":[{"sense":"顧問；建議者","entries":[{"pattern":"academic advisor","pos":"phrase","translation":"學業顧問","explanation":"在美國大學校園生活中常見的搭配，指協助學生選擇課程與規劃學業的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you are not sure which courses to take next semester, you should make an appointment with your <target>academic advisor</target>.","translation":"如果你不確定下學期要修哪些課，你應該約時間諮詢你的學業顧問。"}]},{"pattern":"financial advisor","pos":"phrase","translation":"財務顧問","explanation":"指提供投資建議與理財規劃的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After winning a large amount of money in the lottery, the man hired a professional <target>financial advisor</target> to manage his savings.","translation":"在樂透中贏得一大筆錢後，這個男人雇傭了一位專業的財務顧問來管理他的儲蓄。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"顧問 (同義詞)","entries":[],"synonyms":[{"word":"consultant","pos":"noun","translation":"顧問；諮詢者","explanation":"通常指對特定專業領域提供建議的外部專家"},{"word":"mentor","pos":"noun","translation":"導師；領路人","explanation":"強調指導與長期關係"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 vis (看) + 字尾 -or (人)","related":[{"word":"advise","pos":"verb","translation":"建議","explanation":"advisor 的動詞形式。"},{"word":"advice","pos":"noun","translation":"建議","explanation":"不可數名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"afford","explanation":"「afford」在學測中最高頻的用法是 afford sb. the opportunity to do sth. 或 can/could afford to do sth. 學生必須注意，afford 幾乎總是與助動詞 can, could, be able to 搭配使用，且後方接不定詞 (to V)。","senses":[{"sense":"負擔得起（金錢或時間上）","entries":[{"pattern":"can afford to do sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"能負擔得起做某事","explanation":"指金錢上足夠，可以購買或支付某物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new smartphone is very expensive, so I cannot <target>afford</target> <pattern>to</pattern> buy it until I save enough money from my part-time job.","translation":"這款新智慧型手機非常昂貴，所以我必須存夠兼職工作的錢才能負擔得起購買它。"},{"sentence":"Many poor families in the village cannot <target>afford</target> <pattern>to</pattern> pay for their children's college tuition, forcing them to work early.","translation":"村裡許多貧困家庭負擔不起孩子的大學學費，迫使他們早早開始工作。"}]},{"pattern":"can afford sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"能負擔得起某物","explanation":"及物動詞直接接受詞，受詞通常是金錢或時間。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because he spent all his savings on a luxury car, he could no longer <target>afford</target> a small apartment in the city center.","translation":"因為他把所有積蓄都花在了一輛豪華車上，他再也負擔不起市中心的一個小公寓。"}]},{"pattern":"cannot afford to do sth. (metaphorical)","pos":"phrase","translation":"不能承受（某種結果）","explanation":"比喻用法，指做某事會帶來太大的風險或損失，不能承受其後果。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company is almost bankrupt, so the manager <target>cannot afford</target> <pattern>to</pattern> make any more mistakes in this important project.","translation":"公司幾乎破產了，所以經理不能承受在這次重要專案中再犯任何錯誤。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"提供（機會、幫助等）","entries":[{"pattern":"afford sb. sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"給予某人某物","explanation":"較正式的用法，等同於 give 或 provide。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The modern library <target>affords</target> <pattern>students</pattern> <pattern>the opportunity</pattern> to study in a quiet environment, which helps them concentrate better.","translation":"現代圖書館給予學生在安靜環境中學習的機會，這有助於他們更好地專注。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"負擔","entries":[],"synonyms":[{"word":"manage","pos":"verb","translation":"設法完成；管理","explanation":"強調在困難中設法達成"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"afforded","past_participle":"afforded"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 afford (提供、賦予)","related":[{"word":"affordable","pos":"adjective","translation":"負擔得起的；價格適中的","explanation":"由 afford 加上形容詞字尾 -able 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"afterward","explanation":"「afterward」與「afterwards」在學測中主要作為時間副詞，用來連接兩次動作的發生順序。要注意的是， after-ward 這裡的 -ward 具有「方向」或「時間方向」的指引作用，學生應將其視為連接詞般的副詞，用來標記時間線上的後續動作。","senses":[{"sense":"之後；隨後","entries":[{"pattern":"afterward / afterwards","pos":"adverb","translation":"之後；隨後","explanation":"指在某事發生之後。兩者在語法上幾乎沒有區別，afterwards 較常用於英式英語。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The students first studied the difficult chemistry formulas for two hours, and <target>afterward</target>, they played basketball to relax their minds.","translation":"學生們先花兩 Stunden 學習困難的化學公式，之後他們打籃球來放鬆心情。"},{"sentence":"We had a long and tiring dinner with the family, and <target>afterwards</target>, we decided to take a short walk in the park to digest the food.","translation":"我們與家人共進了一頓漫長且令人疲倦的晚餐，之後我們決定在公園散步一會兒以幫助消化。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"之後","entries":[],"synonyms":[{"word":"subsequently","pos":"adverb","translation":"隨後；接著","explanation":"較正式，常用於論文或學術文章中"},{"word":"later","pos":"adverb","translation":"之後","explanation":"最普遍的用法"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"previously","pos":"adverb","translation":"先前；之前","explanation":"指在事情發生前"},{"word":"word","pos":"adverb","translation":"beforehand","explanation":"事先地"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 after (在...之後) + 字尾 -ward (方向)","related":[{"word":"aftermath","pos":"noun","translation":"餘波；後果","explanation":"指重大災難或事件後留下的影響。"}]}}

{"headword":"agriculture","explanation":"「agriculture」在學測中常出現在環境、食物來源與經濟發展的主題中。學生應注意其作為不可數名詞的用法，以及它與 farming (耕作) 和 cultivation (耕作/培養) 之間的細微差別，後者更偏向於技術性的種植過程。","senses":[{"sense":"農業；農耕業","entries":[{"pattern":"modern agriculture","pos":"phrase","translation":"現代農業","explanation":"指利用科技、化學肥料或機械化來提高產量的農業形式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"With the help of drones and sensors, <pattern>modern</pattern> <target>agriculture</target> can now produce enough food for billions of people worldwide.","translation":"藉由無人機和感測器的幫助，現代農業現在能為全球數十億人生產足夠的食物。"},{"sentence":"The government is investing in <pattern>modern</pattern> <target>agriculture</target> to reduce the reliance on manual labor and increase efficiency.","translation":"政府正投資於現代農業，以減少對人力勞動的依賴並提高效率。"}]},{"pattern":"sustainable agriculture","pos":"phrase","translation":"永續農業","explanation":"強調環境保護與長期生產力的平衡，是環境類文章的高頻搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many farmers are switching to <pattern>sustainable</pattern> <target>agriculture</target> to avoid damaging the soil and protect the local water sources.","translation":"許多農民正轉向永續農業，以避免損壞土壤並保護當地水源。"},{"sentence":"The school's environment club organized a workshop to teach students about the benefits of <pattern>sustainable</pattern> <target>agriculture</target>.","translation":"學校的環境社團舉辦了一場工作坊，教導學生關於永續農業的益處。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"farming","pos":"noun","translation":"農耕","explanation":"較為口語且泛指種植或養殖的行為"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 agri- (田地) + 字尾 -culture (耕作/培養)","related":[{"word":"agricultural","pos":"adjective","translation":"農業的","explanation":"由 agriculture 加上形容詞字尾 -al 延伸而來。"},{"word":"horticulture","pos":"noun","translation":"園藝學","explanation":"字根 horti- (花園) + -culture (耕作)，指種植花卉或果樹。"}]}}

{"headword":"airline","explanation":"「airline」指的是經營航空運輸的「公司」或「業者」。學生容易將其與 airport (機場) 混淆，必須明確區分：airport 是地點，airline 則是提供服務的企業 entity。","senses":[{"sense":"航空公司","entries":[{"pattern":"commercial airline","pos":"phrase","translation":"商業航空公司","explanation":"指提供付費乘客運輸服務的航空公司。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Due to the sudden storm, the <pattern>commercial</pattern> <target>airline</target> canceled all flights to Tokyo for the safety of the passengers.","translation":"由於突然的暴風雨，該商業航空公司為了乘客的安全取消了所有前往東京的航班。"},{"sentence":"Working for a <pattern>commercial</pattern> <target>airline</target> requires excellent communication skills and the ability to handle stressful situations.","translation":"在商業航空公司工作需要卓越的溝通技巧以及處理壓力情境的能力。"}]},{"pattern":"budget airline","pos":"phrase","translation":"廉價航空公司","explanation":"指提供低價票價但服務較少的航空公司。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many college students prefer to fly with a <pattern>budget</pattern> <target>airline</target> because they want to save money for their trip.","translation":"許多大學生偏好搭乘廉價航空公司，因為他們想為旅行省錢。"},{"sentence":"While <pattern>budget</pattern> <target>airlines</target> offer cheaper tickets, you often have to pay extra for baggage and meals.","translation":"雖然廉價航空公司提供較便宜的機票，但你通常必須為行李和餐點支付額外費用。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"air (空氣/空中) + line (路線/線路)","related":[{"word":"flight","pos":"noun","translation":"航班；飛行","explanation":"指一次完整的飛行過程或特定的班次。"}]}}

{"headword":"alley","explanation":"「alley」通常指城市中兩棟建築物之間狹窄的通道。在描述城市景觀或故事場景時非常有用。注意其與 lane (小巷/車道) 的區別：alley 通常更窄且常位於建築物之間。","senses":[{"sense":"小巷；窄巷","entries":[{"pattern":"narrow alley","pos":"phrase","translation":"狹窄的小巷","explanation":"最常見的形容詞搭配，用來描述環境的壓迫感或神秘感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tourist got lost in a <pattern>narrow</pattern> <target>alley</target> in the old city, where the buildings were so close together.","translation":"遊客在舊城區的一條狹窄小巷中迷路了，那裡的建築物靠得非常近。"},{"sentence":"A small coffee shop is hidden in a <pattern>narrow</pattern> <target>alley</target>, making it a secret spot for many local students.","translation":"一家小咖啡店隱藏在狹窄的小巷中，使其成為許多當地學生的秘密地點。"}]},{"pattern":"dark alley","pos":"phrase","translation":"陰暗的小巷","explanation":"常用於描述不安、危險或神秘的氣氛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My father always warns me not to walk alone through a <pattern>dark</pattern> <target>alley</target> late at night for safety reasons.","translation":"為了安全起見，我父親總是警告我深夜不要獨自走過陰暗的小巷。"},{"sentence":"In the scary movie, the main character followed a strange noise into a <pattern>dark</pattern> <target>alley</target> behind the mall.","translation":"在恐怖電影中，主角跟著奇怪的聲音進入了購物中心後方的一條陰暗小巷。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"lane","pos":"noun","translation":"小巷；車道","explanation":"比 alley 更寬一點，且不一定在建築物之間"},{"word":"passage","pos":"noun","translation":"通道","explanation":"泛指任何連接兩地的窄路"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"單一字根，源自古法語，意為「通道」","related":[]}}

{"headword":"almond","explanation":"「almond」在學測中通常出現在營養、健康飲食或文化描述中。它是一個可數名詞，指代個體的杏仁，也可以作為不可數名詞指代該類植物或食材。","senses":[{"sense":"杏仁；杏仁樹","entries":[{"pattern":"roasted almond","pos":"phrase","translation":"烤杏仁","explanation":"常見的食物搭配，描述食材的處理方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My sister loves to eat <pattern>roasted</pattern> <target>almonds</target> as a healthy snack while she is studying for her final exams.","translation":"我姊姊喜歡在準備期末考時吃烤杏仁作為健康零食。"},{"sentence":"The bakery sells a special cake made with <pattern>roasted</pattern> <target>almonds</target>, which tastes very sweet and crunchy.","translation":"這間烘焙店販售一種用烤杏仁製成的特別蛋糕，吃起來非常甜且酥脆。"}]},{"pattern":"almond milk","pos":"phrase","translation":"杏仁奶","explanation":"現代健康飲食或素食話題中極高頻的搭配，用來替代牛奶。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since she is allergic to dairy products, she chooses <target>almond</target> <pattern>milk</pattern> instead of cow's milk in her morning coffee.","translation":"因為她對乳製品過敏，她在早晨的咖啡中選擇杏仁奶而非牛奶。"},{"sentence":"Many people now prefer <target>almond</target> <pattern>milk</pattern> because it is a popular plant-based alternative to traditional dairy.","translation":"許多人現在偏好杏仁奶，因為它是目前流行的植物性乳製品替代品。"}]},{"pattern":"almond-shaped","pos":"adjective","translation":"杏仁形的","explanation":"用來描述眼睛或物體形狀的特徵。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The artist painted the woman's <target>almond</target>-shaped eyes, which made her look very elegant and mysterious.","translation":"藝術家畫出了那名女子的杏仁形眼睛，使她看起來非常優雅且神秘。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"單一字根，源自拉丁語 amygdala (杏仁)","related":[]}}

{"headword":"alphabet","explanation":"「alphabet」指的不是單個字母 (letter)，而是「一套完整的字母表」。學生必須區分 alphabet (字母表) 與 letter (字母) 的概念，這是常考的陷阱點。","senses":[{"sense":"字母表","entries":[{"pattern":"the English alphabet","pos":"phrase","translation":"英文字母表","explanation":"指 A 到 Z 的整套系統。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Children usually begin to learn <pattern>the English</pattern> <target>alphabet</target> in kindergarten, long before they can read full sentences.","translation":"孩子們通常在幼稚園就開始學習英文字母表，早在他們能讀完整句子之前。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to recite <pattern>the English</pattern> <target>alphabet</target> in reverse order to test their memory.","translation":"老師要求學生們反向背誦英文字母表，以測試他們的記憶力。"}]},{"pattern":"Greek alphabet","pos":"phrase","translation":"希臘字母表","explanation":"用於描述其他語言的寫作系統。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In my science class, we learned that the <pattern>Greek</pattern> <target>alphabet</target> is often used in mathematics and physics formulas.","translation":"在我的科學課上，我們 öğrend了希臘字母表經常被用於數學和物理公式中。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自希臘語 alpha (第一個字母) + beta (第二個字母)","related":[{"word":"alphabetical","pos":"adjective","translation":"按字母順序的","explanation":"由 alphabet 加上形容詞字尾 -ical 延伸而來。"},{"word":"alphabetize","pos":"verb","translation":"按字母順序排列","explanation":"由 alphabet 加上動詞字尾 -ize 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"ambassador","explanation":"「ambassador」在學測中常出現在國際關係、外交政策或品牌推廣（如品牌大使）的語境中。理解這個字時，應注意其代表的是一種官方身份或是代表某個組織的代表者。","senses":[{"sense":"大使；外交官（代表國家在外的官方代表）","entries":[{"pattern":"ambassador","pos":"noun","translation":"大使","explanation":"指代表一個國家在另一個國家或國際組織中擔任最高級別的外交官。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The French <target>ambassador</target> met with the local government to discuss how to increase trade and friendship between the two countries.","translation":"法國大使與當地政府會面，討論如何增加兩國之間的貿易與友誼。"}]},{"pattern":"ambassador to sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"駐某地的大使","explanation":"介系詞 to 表示方向或對象，用於標記大使駐紮的國家或組織。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After years of hard work in the foreign service, he was finally appointed as the <target>ambassador</target> <pattern>to</pattern> Japan.","translation":"在外交服務多年後，他終於被任命為駐日大使。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"代表者；品牌大使（代表某個組織、理念或品牌的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"brand ambassador","pos":"phrase","translation":"品牌大使","explanation":"現代商業語境中，名人或專業人士被聘請來代表品牌，提升其知名度。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The famous basketball player became a <pattern>brand</pattern> <target>ambassador</target> for the new sports shoes, appearing in many television commercials.","translation":"這位著名的籃球員成為了這款新運動鞋的品牌大使，出現在許多電視廣告中。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 ambassador (大使)","related":[{"word":"ambassadorial","pos":"adjective","translation":"大使的；外交的","explanation":"由名詞 ambassador 加上形容詞字尾 -ial 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"ambition","explanation":"「ambition」在學測中通常與個人成長、職業規劃或社會成就相關。注意此字在描述「志向」或「野心」時，中文翻譯會根據上下文而定，有時是正面地指代目標，有時則是帶有負面色彩。","senses":[{"sense":"抱負；志向（強烈的渴望達到某種成功或權力）","entries":[{"pattern":"ambition","pos":"noun","translation":"抱負；志向","explanation":"指對成功的強烈渴望，通常是指一個長期的目標。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since he was a small child, his greatest <target>ambition</target> has been to travel the world and learn about different cultures.","translation":"自從小時候起，他最大的抱負就是環遊世界並學習不同的文化。"}]},{"pattern":"have ambition to do sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"有志向去做某事","explanation":"後接不定詞 (to V) 作為抱負的具體內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young lawyer had a strong <target>ambition</target> <pattern>to</pattern> become the head of the law firm within ten years.","translation":"這位年輕的律師有強烈的志向在十年內成為律師事務所的負責人。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"目標；企圖（具體地想要實現的某件事）","entries":[{"pattern":"one's ambition","pos":"phrase","translation":"某人的志向","explanation":"常用於描述個人目標。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Winning the gold medal at the Olympics was her lifelong <target>ambition</target>, and she practiced hard every single day.","translation":"在奧運會上贏得金牌是她終生的志向，而她每天都努力練習。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 ambit (走、環繞) + 字尾 -ion (名詞)","related":[{"word":"ambitious","pos":"adjective","translation":"有抱負的；野心勃勃的","explanation":"由名詞 ambition 加上形容詞字尾 -ous 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"angel","explanation":"「angel」在學測中通常出現在文學、宗教或比喻義的描述中。除了其原始的宗教意義，它常被用來比喻指代那些善良、純潔或提供幫助的人。","senses":[{"sense":"天使（宗教或神話中的靈魂）","entries":[{"pattern":"angel","pos":"noun","translation":"天使","explanation":"指宗教或神話中代表神靈的靈魂。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the classic painting, the beautiful <target>angel</target> with white wings was floating in the sky, watching over the sleeping child.","translation":"在經典的畫作中，帶著白色翅膀的美麗天使正漂浮在空中，看著熟睡的孩子。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"善良的人（比喻義，指提供幫助或極其純潔的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"be an angel","pos":"phrase","translation":"像天使一樣善良","explanation":"比喻指某人極其善良或在關鍵時刻提供幫助。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Thank you so much for helping me move all these heavy boxes to the next floor; you <target>are</target> <pattern>an</pattern> <target>angel</target>!","translation":"非常感謝你幫我搬這些沉重的箱子到樓上；你真是個天使！"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 angel (使者、傳遞者)","related":[{"word":"evangelist","pos":"noun","translation":"福音傳道者","explanation":"字首 e- (出) + 字根 angel (使者)，指傳播福音的人。"}]}}

{"headword":"apron","explanation":"「apron」是一個基礎生活類名詞，通常出現在描述家庭生活、烹飪或專業工作場景的閱讀中。","senses":[{"sense":"圍裙","entries":[{"pattern":"apron","pos":"noun","translation":"圍裙","explanation":"指穿在衣服外面以防止弄髒的保護衣物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My mother always wears a thick <target>apron</target> when she is baking cakes in the kitchen to keep her dress clean.","translation":"我母親在廚房烤蛋糕時總是穿著一件厚圍裙，以保持她的衣服乾淨。"},{"sentence":"The chef tied his white <target>apron</target> tightly around his waist before starting to prepare the dinner for the guests.","translation":"主廚在開始為客人準備晚餐前，將他的白色圍裙緊緊地繫在腰間。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"armed","explanation":"「armed」在學測中常用作形容詞，描述人物或武裝力量。要注意其在「武裝」與「提供設備」兩種語義上的延展。","senses":[{"sense":"武裝的；攜帶武器的","entries":[{"pattern":"be armed with sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"攜帶／武裝某物","explanation":"指攜帶武器，或比喻地攜帶知識、資訊等防禦或攻擊工具。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police officers were <target>armed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> pistols to ensure that they could protect the citizens during the dangerous mission.","translation":"警察們攜帶了手槍，以確保他們在危險任務中能保護市民。"},{"sentence":"The student went into the exam room <target>armed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a clear plan and a lot of confidence to get a high score.","translation":"這名學生帶著明確的計畫與充足的自信進入考場，以期獲得高分。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"weaponized","pos":"adjective","translation":"武器化的","explanation":"指將某物轉變為武器"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unarmed","pos":"adjective","translation":"未武裝的；不攜帶武器的","explanation":"直接在 armed 前加上否定前綴 un-"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"來自動詞 arm (武裝) 的過去分詞形式，後轉為形容詞","related":[{"word":"armory","pos":"noun","translation":"軍械庫","explanation":"存放武器的地方。"},{"word":"disarm","pos":"verb","translation":"解除武裝","explanation":"字首 dis- (除去) + arm (武器)。"}]}}

{"headword":"arrest","explanation":"「arrest」在法律、犯罪類閱讀測驗中是極其高頻的字彙。學生需區分其作為動詞（逮捕）與名詞（逮捕、停止）的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"逮捕；拘留（法律上的強制力），或指停止某種進展","entries":[{"pattern":"arrest sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"逮捕某人","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接受詞，指警察或官方力量將某人拘捕。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police decided to <target>arrest</target> the thief after they found the stolen jewelry hidden inside his small old suitcase.","translation":"警察在發現被盜的珠寶藏在他那個舊小行李箱中後，決定逮捕該名小偷。"},{"sentence":"If you break the law and hurt other people, the authorities will eventually <target>arrest</target> you and take you to court.","translation":"如果你違法並傷害他人，當局最終會逮捕你並將你送上法庭。"}]},{"pattern":"under arrest","pos":"phrase","translation":"被逮捕","explanation":"名詞用法，常用於警察對嫌疑人的正式宣告。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The officer put handcuffs on the man and told him that he was <pattern>under</pattern> <target>arrest</target> for stealing the car.","translation":"警官給那名男子戴上 handcuffs 並告訴他，他因為偷車而被捕。"}]},{"pattern":"arrest the development of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"阻止／停止某事的發展","explanation":"較為正式的用法，指停止某個過程或進展（如疾病或經濟衰退）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The doctors gave the patient a strong medicine to <target>arrest</target> the <pattern>development</pattern> of the disease before it became too dangerous.","translation":"醫生給予病患強效藥物，以在疾病變得太危險之前阻止其發展。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"apprehend","pos":"verb","translation":"逮捕；拘捕","explanation":"較為正式的法律用語"},{"word":"capture","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉；捕獲","explanation":"強調從追逐中抓到"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"release","pos":"verb","translation":"釋放","explanation":"指將被捕之人釋放"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"arrested","past_participle":"arrested"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 arrest (停止、逮捕)","related":[{"word":"arresting","pos":"adjective","translation":"引人注目的","explanation":"字面意為能「停止」路人的目光，因此指引人注目的。"}]}}

{"headword":"ash","explanation":"「ash」在學測中主要出現在環境保護、地質災害（如火山爆發）或描述火災後的殘骸中。注意其作為不可數名詞時指「灰燼」，但描述特定種類的樹木時則指「梣樹」。","senses":[{"sense":"灰燼；火山灰（燃燒後或噴發後的殘留物）","entries":[{"pattern":"ash","pos":"noun","translation":"灰燼；火山灰","explanation":"指物質燃燒後留下的細小灰白色粉末，或火山噴發時排出的碎屑。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the massive forest fire was finally put out, a thick layer of gray <target>ash</target> covered the entire valley.","translation":"在大規模森林火災終於被撲滅後，一層厚厚的灰色灰燼覆蓋了整個山谷。"},{"sentence":"The eruption of the volcano sent clouds of volcanic <target>ash</target> high into the air, causing flights to be canceled across the country.","translation":"火山噴發將火山灰雲送入高空，導致全國範圍內的航班被取消。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cinders","pos":"noun","translation":"餘燼；煤渣","explanation":"指燃燒後留下的焦黑碎塊"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"aside","explanation":"「aside」在閱讀測驗中常作為副詞，表示將某物「移開」或「暫時擱置」。在寫作中，它也常出現在 fixed phrase 中，用來表示對主線話題的暫時偏離。","senses":[{"sense":"在旁邊；向一邊（空間上的移動或位置）","entries":[{"pattern":"move / push sth. aside","pos":"phrase","translation":"將某物移到一邊","explanation":"指物理上將某物推開，以便騰出空間或看到後方的東西。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The curious boy <target>pushed</target> the heavy curtains <pattern>aside</pattern> to see if the rain had finally stopped outside.","translation":"那個好奇的男孩將沉重的窗簾推到一邊，看看外面的雨是否終於停了。"},{"sentence":"Please <target>move</target> your bags <pattern>aside</pattern> so that other students can walk through the narrow hallway without any trouble.","translation":"請將你的袋子移到一邊，以便其他學生可以毫無困難地走過狹窄的走廊。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sideways","pos":"adverb","translation":"向側邊地","explanation":"單純描述方向"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"暫時擱置（抽象意義上的暫停）","entries":[{"pattern":"set / put sth. aside","pos":"phrase","translation":"將某事暫時擱置／儲存","explanation":"可指儲存金錢或時間，或暫時停止討論某個爭議，以專注於目前更重要的事。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The two political leaders decided to <target>put</target> their differences <pattern>aside</pattern> and work together to solve the global warming crisis.","translation":"這兩位政治領袖決定暫時擱置他們的分歧，共同努力解決全球暖化危機。"},{"sentence":"Every month, the young worker <target>sets</target> <pattern>aside</pattern> a small part of his salary to save for his future college tuition.","translation":"每個月，這位年輕工人會撥出一小部分薪水，為他未來的大學學費儲蓄。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"reserve","pos":"verb","translation":"保留；預留","explanation":"強調為特定目的而儲存"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"athlete","explanation":"「athlete」在學測中常用於描述運動員的身體素質、訓練過程或在面對壓力時的心理韌性。注意它是一個泛稱，涵蓋所有參與體育競技的人，不限於特定運動項目。","senses":[{"sense":"運動員；體育競技者","entries":[{"pattern":"athlete","pos":"noun","translation":"運動員","explanation":"指參與體育競賽或進行高強度體能訓練的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young <target>athlete</target> spent four hours every morning running on the track to prepare for the national championship.","translation":"這位年輕的運動員每天早晨花四個小時在跑道上跑步，為全國錦標賽做準備。"},{"sentence":"Professional <target>athletes</target> often follow a strict diet and training schedule to keep their bodies in top condition.","translation":"專業運動員通常遵循嚴格的飲食和訓練計畫，以保持身體處於最佳狀態。"}]},{"pattern":"student-athlete","pos":"noun","translation":"學生運動員","explanation":"在校園生活中，指同時兼顧學業與體育競賽的學生。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Being a <target>student-athlete</target> is difficult because they must balance their hard training sessions with late-night studying.","translation":"成為一名學生運動員是很困難的，因為他們必須在艱苦的訓練課與深夜讀書之間取得平衡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"sportsman","pos":"noun","translation":"運動員","explanation":"較傳統的說法，有時也指具有運動精神的人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"源自希臘語 athlētēs (競賽者)","related":[{"word":"athletic","pos":"adjective","translation":"運動的；體格強健的","explanation":"描述人的體型或與運動相關的事物。"},{"word":"athletics","pos":"noun","translation":"田徑運動；體育","explanation":"指體育競技這門學科或特定的田徑項目。"}]}}

{"headword":"attitude","explanation":"「attitude」在學測中常出現於心理學、社會行為或個人成長類的文章。它不僅指對某事物的「態度」，更強調一種長期持有的「心態」或「看法」。","senses":[{"sense":"態度；看法；心態","entries":[{"pattern":"attitude toward sth./sb.","pos":"phrase","translation":"對某事／某人的態度","explanation":"最常見的搭配，toward 之後接對象，描述對特定事物或人的主觀看法。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The teacher noticed that the student's <target>attitude</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> learning English had become much more positive over the semester.","translation":"老師注意到這位學生對學習英文的態度在學期中變得積極許多。"},{"sentence":"Many young people have a different <target>attitude</target> <pattern>toward</pattern> protecting the environment compared to their grandparents' generation.","translation":"與祖父母那一代相比，許多年輕人對保護環境持有不同的看法。"}]},{"pattern":"positive / negative attitude","pos":"phrase","translation":"積極／消極的態度","explanation":"常用形容詞來修飾心態的性質，用來對比兩種不同的應對方式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Having a <target>positive attitude</target> is essential when facing failure, as it helps you find solutions instead of giving up.","translation":"面對失敗時擁有積極的態度至關重要，因為這能幫助你找到解決方案而非輕言放棄。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"perspective","pos":"noun","translation":"觀點；視角","explanation":"強調從特定角度看待事物的看法"},{"word":"outlook","pos":"noun","translation":"前景；展望；心態","explanation":"通常指對未來或生活的整體看法"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 attitud (姿勢、狀態)","related":[{"word":"attitudinal","pos":"adjective","translation":"態度的","explanation":"與態度相關的形容詞形態。"}]}}

{"headword":"attract","explanation":"「attract」在學測中常用於描述自然現象（如磁鐵、昆蟲）、社會吸引力（如觀光、人才）或心理上的引起注意。核心概念是「將某物拉向自己」。","senses":[{"sense":"吸引；引起（注意、興趣）","entries":[{"pattern":"attract sb. to sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"吸引某人對某事感興趣","explanation":"描述將某人的注意力或情感拉向特定對象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The colorful flowers in the garden <target>attract</target> <pattern>many</pattern> bees and butterflies during the warm spring months.","translation":"花園裡色彩鮮豔的花朵在溫暖的春季吸引了許多蜜蜂和蝴蝶。"},{"sentence":"The city's beautiful museums and old streets <target>attract</target> <pattern>thousands of</pattern> tourists every year from all over the world.","translation":"這座城市美麗的博物館和古街道每年吸引來自世界各地的數千名遊客。"}]},{"pattern":"attract attention","pos":"phrase","translation":"引起注意","explanation":"固定搭配，用於描述某物因其特徵而讓他人注意到。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young artist tried to <target>attract</target> the <pattern>attention</pattern> of the judges by using bright colors and strange shapes in his painting.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家試圖透過在畫作中使用鮮豔的顏色和奇異的形狀來引起評審的注意。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"draw","pos":"verb","translation":"吸引；拉","explanation":"比 attract 更口語，常用於 draw attention 或 draw a crowd"},{"word":"allure","pos":"verb","translation":"誘惑；吸引","explanation":"強調具有強烈的魅力或誘惑力"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"repel","pos":"verb","translation":"排斥；擊退","explanation":"物理上或心理上的排斥，與 attract 相對"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"attracted","past_participle":"attracted"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 ad- (朝向) + 字根 tract (拉)","related":[{"word":"attraction","pos":"noun","translation":"吸引力；景點","explanation":"指吸引人的東西或吸引的動作。"},{"word":"distract","pos":"verb","translation":"分心；分散注意力","explanation":"字首 dis- (分開) + 字根 tract (拉)，意為將注意力拉開。"},{"word":"extract","pos":"verb","translation":"提取；取出","explanation":"字首 ex- (向外) + 字根 tract (拉)，意為向外拉出。"}]}}

{"headword":"attractive","explanation":"「attractive」是一個基礎形容詞，在學測中除了指人的外貌「迷人」外，更常用於描述計畫、價格或機會「具有吸引力的（有利的）」。","senses":[{"sense":"吸引人的；迷人的","entries":[{"pattern":"attractive","pos":"adjective","translation":"迷人的；吸引人的","explanation":"描述外觀上的美感或魅力。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small bookstore in the alley is very <target>attractive</target> with its warm lights and old wooden shelves.","translation":"小巷子裡的那家書店非常吸引人，因為它有溫暖的燈光和舊木製書架。"}]},{"pattern":"an attractive offer / price","pos":"phrase","translation":"誘人的條件／價格","explanation":"描述某個方案或價格對某人來說非常有利且吸引人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company offered him an <target>attractive</target> <pattern>salary</pattern> and a private office, so he decided to join their team immediately.","translation":"公司給他提供了誘人的薪水和私人辦公室，所以他決定立即加入他們的團隊。"},{"sentence":"Because the hotel was on sale, the <target>attractive</target> <pattern>price</pattern> made many travelers decide to stay there for a week.","translation":"因為酒店在打折，誘人的價格讓許多旅客決定在那裡住一個星期。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"appealing","pos":"adjective","translation":"吸引人的；有魅力的","explanation":"強調讓人感到愉快或感興趣"},{"word":"charming","pos":"adjective","translation":"迷人的；有魅力的","explanation":"通常指人的個性或小地方的魅力"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unattractive","pos":"adjective","translation":"不吸引人的；醜陋的","explanation":"直接在前面加上否定前綴 un-"},{"word":"repulsive","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人厭惡的","explanation":"強烈地讓人不想靠近"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 attract 加上形容詞字尾 -ive","related":[{"word":"attractively","pos":"adverb","translation":"吸引人地","explanation":"副詞形態。"}]}}

{"headword":"awake","explanation":"「awake」在學測中可作為形容詞與動詞使用。作為形容詞時，指「醒著的」；作為動詞時，指「使醒來」。注意其與 wake 和 awaken 的微小差異：awake 通常指狀態，而 wake/awaken 更加強調動作。","senses":[{"sense":"醒著的（形容詞：描述狀態）","entries":[{"pattern":"awake","pos":"adjective","translation":"醒著的","explanation":"常用於 be awake 或 stay awake，描述一個人處於不睡眠的狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The student stayed <target>awake</target> until midnight to finish his history project, although he felt very tired and sleepy.","translation":"那名學生為了完成他的歷史專案，一直醒著直到午夜，儘管他感到非常疲倦且昏昏欲睡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"conscious","pos":"adjective","translation":"清醒的；有意識的","explanation":"強調意識清醒，可用於醫療情境"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"asleep","pos":"adjective","translation":"睡著的","explanation":"awake 的直接對立面"}]},{"sense":"喚醒；使醒來（動詞：描述動作）","entries":[{"pattern":"awake from sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"從…中醒來","explanation":"描述從睡眠或夢境中恢復意識的過程。","sentences":[{"sentence":"She suddenly <target>awoke</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a terrible nightmare and found herself breathing fast and sweating in the dark.","translation":"她突然從一個可怕的噩夢中醒來，發現自己在黑暗中快速呼吸且出汗。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"wake","pos":"verb","translation":"喚醒；醒來","explanation":"最常用的動作動詞"},{"word":"awaken","pos":"verb","translation":"喚醒","explanation":"較為正式的動作動詞"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"fall asleep","pos":"phrase","translation":"睡著","explanation":"動作的轉變"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"awoke","past_participle":"awoken"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awakening","pos":"noun","translation":"覺醒；醒來","explanation":"指意識的覺醒或從睡眠中醒來。"}]}}

{"headword":"awaken","explanation":"「awaken」比「awake」或「wake」更正式且更常被用於抽象的語境中。在學測中，它不僅指生理上的喚醒，更常指「喚醒（某種情感、記憶或意識）」，這是其高頻考點。","senses":[{"sense":"喚醒；使醒來（生理上的動作）","entries":[{"pattern":"awaken sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"喚醒某人","explanation":"及物動詞，指將某人從睡眠中弄醒。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The loud noise of the fire alarm <target>awakened</target> all the students in the dormitory, causing them to run outside quickly.","translation":"火警警報的巨大的噪音喚醒了宿舍裡所有的學生，導致他們快速地跑向室外。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"wake","pos":"verb","translation":"喚醒","explanation":"日常用語"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"lull","pos":"verb","translation":"使入睡；使平靜","explanation":"指將某人哄睡"}]},{"sense":"激發；喚起（抽象情感或記憶）","entries":[{"pattern":"awaken sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"喚起…（情感、記憶等）","explanation":"常用於描述音樂、藝術或某種經歷喚起內心的深層情感或記憶。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old photographs of his grandfather's village <target>awakened</target> a strong feeling of nostalgia in the young man's heart.","translation":"他祖父村莊的老照片在那個年輕人的心中喚起了一種強烈的懷舊之情。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"evoke","pos":"verb","translation":"喚起；引起","explanation":"指透過某種外部刺激喚起記憶或情感"},{"word":" arouse","pos":"verb","translation":"激發；引起","explanation":"指引起某人的興趣或好奇心"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"awakened","past_participle":"awakened"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awake","pos":"adjective","translation":"醒著的","explanation":"基礎形容詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"badly","explanation":"「badly」在學測中具有兩種截然不同的用法：一是修飾動詞，表示「糟糕地」；二是作為程度副詞，表示「非常、迫切地」，後者是閱讀理解與克漏字的關鍵考點。","senses":[{"sense":"糟糕地；拙劣地（表現或品質低下）","entries":[{"pattern":"be badly + adjective","pos":"phrase","translation":"嚴重地…","explanation":"常用於描述受損程度嚴重，例如 badly damaged 或 badly hurt。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old wooden bridge was <target>badly</target> <pattern>damaged</pattern> during the heavy storm, making it unsafe for cars to cross.","translation":"這座古老的木橋在強風暴中受損嚴重，導致汽車無法安全通過。"}]},{"pattern":"do sth. badly","pos":"phrase","translation":"拙劣地做某事","explanation":"指做事缺乏技巧或品質不佳。","sentences":[{"sentence":"He felt very embarrassed because he had <target>badly</target> performed his piano piece during the school music concert.","translation":"他感到非常尷尬，因為他在學校音樂會上拙劣地演奏了他的鋼琴曲。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"well","pos":"adverb","translation":"良好地","explanation":"指表現或結果令人滿意。"}]},{"sense":"非常；迫切地（強烈的渴望）","entries":[{"pattern":"badly need / want sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"迫切需要／想要某事","explanation":"在此語境下，badly 等同於 very much 或 desperately，是學測高頻搭配。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After walking for five hours in the hot sun, the tired hikers <target>badly</target> <pattern>needed</pattern> a cold bottle of water.","translation":"在烈日下行走五小時後，疲憊的登山客迫切需要一瓶冰水。"},{"sentence":"The poor village <target>badly</target> <pattern>wants</pattern> a new medical clinic so that elderly people can get treatment without traveling far.","translation":"這個貧窮的村莊迫切想要一座新的醫療診所，好讓老人們不必遠行就能接受治療。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"desperately","pos":"adverb","translation":"極其；迫切地","explanation":"強調一種絕望或極其強烈的需求。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 bad 加上副詞字尾 -ly","related":[]}}

{"headword":"bait","explanation":"「bait」在學測中可作為名詞與動詞使用。其核心概念是「誘餌」，無論是實體（如釣魚）或是抽象（如誘惑、欺騙），學生需能辨識其在不同情境中的應用。","senses":[{"sense":"誘餌（用來吸引魚或動物的食物）","entries":[{"pattern":"bait","pos":"noun","translation":"誘餌","explanation":"指用於釣魚或捕捉動物的食物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young boy spent the whole afternoon putting worms as <target>bait</target> on his hook to catch a big fish.","translation":"那個小男孩花了一整個下午將蚯蚓作為誘餌放在魚鉤上，以捕捉一條大魚。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"誘惑；欺騙（用利益吸引某人做某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"take the bait","pos":"phrase","translation":"上鉤；受誘惑","explanation":"比喻用法。指被對方的陷阱或誘惑吸引而採取行動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The salesman offered a huge discount to attract customers, and many people <target>took</target> <pattern>the bait</pattern> and bought the expensive phone.","translation":"銷售員提供巨大的折扣以吸引顧客，許多人因此上鉤並買了那款昂貴的手機。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"lure","pos":"noun","translation":"誘惑；誘餌","explanation":"可作為名詞或動詞。"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"誘捕；挑釁（作為動詞使用）","entries":[{"pattern":"bait sth./sb.","pos":"verb","translation":"用誘餌吸引；挑釁某人","explanation":"及物動詞。指使用食物吸引動物，或用言語挑釁他人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hunter <target>baited</target> the trap with cheese to catch the mouse that had been eating all the grains in the kitchen.","translation":"獵人利用起司作為誘餌來設置陷阱，以捕捉那隻一直在廚房吃穀物的老鼠。"},{"sentence":"Some people on the internet often <target>bait</target> others by posting angry comments to start a fight in the comment section.","translation":"一些網路上的使用者經常透過發布憤怒的評論來挑釁他人，以便在評論區發起爭執。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"provoke","pos":"verb","translation":"挑釁；激怒","explanation":"指用言語或行動故意地讓對方生氣。"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"baited","past_participle":"baited"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bamboo","explanation":"「bamboo」在學測中常出現在自然地理或環保議題的閱讀測驗中。它不僅指一種植物，有時也會出現在討論永續材質（Sustainable Materials）的文章中，用以取代塑膠製品。","senses":[{"sense":"竹子（一種快速生長的草本植物）","entries":[{"pattern":"bamboo","pos":"noun","translation":"竹子","explanation":"指這種植物本身或其材質，常與生長速度或環保用途相關聯。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because <target>bamboo</target> grows so quickly, many companies now produce eco-friendly toothbrushes and straws made from this strong plant.","translation":"因為竹子生長得如此快速，許多公司現在生產由這種強韌植物製成的環保牙刷和吸管。"},{"sentence":"Pandas spend most of their day eating fresh <target>bamboo</target> shoots, which provide the energy they need to survive in the wild.","translation":"大熊貓一天中大部分的時間都在吃新鮮的竹筍，這為牠們在野外生存提供了所需的能量。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bang","explanation":"「bang」是一個多功能字，在閱讀測驗中可能作為名詞（巨大的聲響）、動詞（猛擊）或副詞（突然）。學生應根據其在句子中的位置判斷其詞性與意義。","senses":[{"sense":"巨大的聲響（突然且強烈的噪音）","entries":[{"pattern":"a loud bang","pos":"phrase","translation":"巨大的砰聲","explanation":"常用於描述突發事件，如爆炸或重物摔落，增加情境的臨場感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The silence of the library was suddenly broken by a loud <target>bang</target> when a heavy book fell off the shelf.","translation":"圖書館的寂靜突然被一聲巨大的砰聲打破，當時一本沉重的書從書架上掉下來。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"blast","pos":"noun","translation":"爆炸聲；強風","explanation":"強調爆裂的強烈噪音"},{"word":"crash","pos":"noun","translation":"碰撞聲；破碎聲","explanation":"強調物體撞擊產生的噪音"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"猛擊；敲擊（強而有力地撞擊某物）","entries":[{"pattern":"bang sth. against sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"將某物猛擊在某物上","explanation":"描述動作的強度與速度，常用於表達憤怒或意外。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In a fit of anger, the boy <target>banged</target> <pattern>his fist against</pattern> the wooden table, making everyone in the classroom jump.","translation":"男孩在憤怒之中，將拳頭猛擊在木桌上，讓教室裡的每個人都嚇了一跳。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"strike","pos":"verb","translation":"擊打；敲擊","explanation":"較為正式的擊打動作"},{"word":"hit","pos":"verb","translation":"撞擊；擊打","explanation":"最普遍的擊打動詞"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"突然地（用作副詞，表示動作的突然性）","entries":[{"pattern":"bang into sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"突然撞到某物","explanation":"非正式用法，強調動作發生得極其突然且不小心。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While walking through the crowded hallway, I <target>banged</target> <pattern>into</pattern> my old friend from primary school by complete accident.","translation":"在走過擁擠的走廊時，我不小心突然撞到了我國小時期的老朋友。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"banged","past_participle":"banged"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"banker","explanation":"「banker」是指在銀行工作的人員，但在學測中常出現在討論金融體系、經濟危機或商業管理類型的文章中，用以代表銀行業的專業人士。","senses":[{"sense":"銀行家；銀行業從業人員","entries":[{"pattern":"banker","pos":"noun","translation":"銀行家","explanation":"指從事銀行業的人，通常指具有一定職位或影響力的專業人士。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The experienced <target>banker</target> provided valuable advice on how to manage personal savings and invest in the stock market safely.","translation":"那位經驗豐富的銀行家針對如何管理個人儲蓄以及安全地投資股票市場提供了寶貴的建議。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 bank (銀行) + 名詞字尾 -er (人)","related":[{"word":"bank","pos":"noun","translation":"銀行","explanation":"基礎名詞。"},{"word":"bankrupt","pos":"adjective","translation":"破產的","explanation":"指財務狀況極差，無法償還債務。"}]}}

{"headword":"bare","explanation":"「bare」在學測中常被與「bear (忍受)」混淆。其核心意義是「沒有覆蓋物」或「僅僅」。在描述環境、身體部位或揭露真相時非常高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"裸露的；不覆蓋的（物理上的裸露）","entries":[{"pattern":"bare","pos":"adjective","translation":"裸露的","explanation":"描述物體表面沒有衣服、毛髮或覆蓋物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hikers walked with <target>bare</target> feet on the hot sand, feeling the intense heat of the summer sun.","translation":"登山客們赤腳走在發燙的沙灘上，感受著夏季陽光的強烈熱度。"},{"sentence":"After the heavy storm, several <target>bare</target> trees stood in the field, their leaves all blown away by the wind.","translation":"在強大的風暴後，幾棵裸露的（落葉）樹木立在原野上，葉子都被風吹走了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"naked","pos":"adjective","translation":"裸體的；不覆蓋的","explanation":"強調完全沒有覆蓋物"},{"word":"uncovered","pos":"adjective","translation":"未覆蓋的","explanation":"指表面被揭開或沒有遮蔽"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"covered","pos":"adjective","translation":"覆蓋的","explanation":"指表面有遮蔽物"}]},{"sense":"僅僅的；最基本的（抽象上的簡陋）陋","entries":[{"pattern":"the bare minimum","pos":"phrase","translation":"最低限度","explanation":"極為高頻的片語，指僅僅滿足基本需求而沒有任何額外地修飾或增加。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The student only did the <target>bare</target> <pattern>minimum</pattern> for his homework, so the teacher gave him a low grade.","translation":"這個學生在做作業時僅僅做了最低限度，所以老師給了他一個低分。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"basic","pos":"adjective","translation":"基本的","explanation":"指最基礎、沒有修飾的"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"揭露；展現（動詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"bare sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"揭露；展現","explanation":"指將原本被遮蓋住的東西揭開或展現出來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The dog <target>bared</target> <pattern>its teeth</pattern> at the stranger, showing a clear sign that it was ready to attack.","translation":"這隻狗對著陌生人露出牙齒，顯示出它準備攻擊的明顯跡象。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"reveal","pos":"verb","translation":"揭露；顯露","explanation":"更正式的揭露動作"},{"word":"expose","pos":"verb","translation":"暴露；使顯露","explanation":"指將遮蔽物移開以顯露內部"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bared","past_participle":"bared"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"barely","explanation":"「barely」在學測中是一個極為重要的程度副詞，常用於否定句中表示「幾乎不」或「僅僅」。學生應將其與「hardly」和「scarcely」視為同義詞，這是克漏字與翻譯題的關鍵考點。","senses":[{"sense":"幾乎不；僅僅（表示程度極低）","entries":[{"pattern":"barely","pos":"adverb","translation":"幾乎不；僅僅","explanation":"用來修飾動詞或形容詞，表示事情發生在臨界點上，幾乎沒有發生。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The room was so noisy that I could <target>barely</target> hear what the teacher was saying during the lecture.","translation":"房間裡太吵了，以至於我在講座期間幾乎聽不到老師在說什麼。"},{"sentence":"Because he had spent all his money on video games, he <target>barely</target> had enough money for a simple lunch.","translation":"因為他把所有的錢都花在電子遊戲上，他僅僅有足夠的錢買一份簡單的午餐。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hardly","pos":"adverb","translation":"幾乎不","explanation":"最常用的同義詞"},{"word":"scarcely","pos":"adverb","translation":"幾乎不","explanation":"較為正式的用法"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"completely","pos":"adverb","translation":"完全地","explanation":" "}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"形容詞 bare 加上副詞字尾 -ly","related":[{"word":"bare","pos":"adjective","translation":"裸露的；僅僅的","explanation":"基礎形容詞型態。"}]}}

{"headword":"barn","explanation":"「barn」通常出現在關於鄉村生活、農業或自然環境的閱讀測驗中。在學測中，它不僅指存放農作物或牲畜的場所，有時也可用於描述鄉村景觀的典型特徵。","senses":[{"sense":"穀倉；牲畜棚（農場中用來存放穀物或飼養動物的建築物）","entries":[{"pattern":"barn","pos":"noun","translation":"穀倉；牲畜棚","explanation":"指農場中大型的儲存空間或動物棲息處。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farmer stored all the harvested corn in the huge red <target>barn</target> to keep it dry and safe from the rain.","translation":"農夫將所有收割的玉米儲存在巨大的紅色穀倉中，以保持乾燥並防止被雨淋。"},{"sentence":"During the cold winter months, the cows and sheep are kept inside the warm <target>barn</target> to protect them from the freezing wind.","translation":"在寒冷的冬季月份，牛隻與羊隻被安置在溫暖的牲畜棚內，以保護它們免受寒風之苦。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"granary","pos":"noun","translation":"穀倉","explanation":"專指儲存穀類的地方"},{"word":"stable","pos":"noun","translation":"馬廄","explanation":"專指飼養馬匹的場所"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"barrel","explanation":"「barrel」在描述物品儲存、工業產品或某些特定習慣（如酒桶、油桶）時會出現。在學測中，要注意它既可以是名詞（容器）也可以是動詞（快速奔跑），但名詞用法最為高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"圓桶；木桶（圓柱形的大容器）","entries":[{"pattern":"barrel","pos":"noun","translation":"圓桶；木桶","explanation":"指圓柱形的容器，通常用於儲存液體或粉末。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The workers carefully rolled the heavy <target>barrel</target> of oil across the factory floor to the shipping area.","translation":"工人們小心地將沉重的油桶在工廠地板上滾動，將其移至運輸區域。"},{"sentence":"In the old days, people used wooden <target>barrels</target> to store salted fish and wine for long journeys across the sea.","translation":"在舊時代，人們使用木桶來儲存鹽魚和葡萄酒，以便於進行長距離的海上航行。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"drum","pos":"noun","translation":"圓桶","explanation":"常用於工業用的大桶"},{"word":"container","pos":"noun","translation":"容器","explanation":"泛指所有儲物容器"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":" barreled","past_participle":" barreled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"basement","explanation":"「basement」是基礎的居住環境詞彙，常用於描述房屋結構或儲存空間。在學測中，常出現在描述家庭生活或故事背景的段落中。","senses":[{"sense":"地下室","entries":[{"pattern":"basement","pos":"noun","translation":"地下室","explanation":"指房屋最底層，位於地面之下的空間。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because it was too noisy upstairs, the student went down to the <target>basement</target> to study for his final exams in peace.","translation":"因為樓上太吵了，那名學生走到地下室，以便安靜地準備期末考。"},{"sentence":"My parents decided to turn the dusty old <target>basement</target> into a modern game room for the children to enjoy.","translation":"我的父母決定將佈滿灰塵的舊地下室改成一個現代化的遊戲室，讓孩子們享受。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cellar","pos":"noun","translation":"地下室；酒窖","explanation":"通常指較小或較陰暗的儲藏室"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"attic","pos":"noun","translation":"閣樓","explanation":"房屋最頂層的空間"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 base (底部) + 字尾 -ment (名詞)","related":[{"word":"base","pos":"noun","translation":"底部；基礎","explanation":"核心基礎詞彙"}]}}

{"headword":"bay","explanation":"「bay」在地理類閱讀中非常高頻。要注意它有兩個完全不同的意思：一是地理上的「海灣」，二是建築上的「隔間」，但在學測中，地理意義最為核心。","senses":[{"sense":"海灣（陸地向海洋延伸的凹陷部分）","entries":[{"pattern":"bay","pos":"noun","translation":"海灣","explanation":"指陸地向海洋凹進去的部分，水域通常較為平靜。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many small fishing boats are safely anchored in the calm <target>bay</target>, waiting for the storm to pass before they sail again.","translation":"許多小型漁船安全地停泊在平靜的海灣中，等待風暴過去後再次出航。"},{"sentence":"The tourists enjoyed a beautiful walk along the sandy beach of the <target>bay</target>, admiring the blue water and the white sand.","translation":"遊客們在海灣的沙灘上享受了一次美麗的散步，欣賞著藍色的海水與白色的沙子。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"gulf","pos":"noun","translation":"灣；海灣","explanation":"通常指規模較大的海灣"},{"word":"cove","pos":"noun","translation":"小海灣","explanation":"指規模較小的、隱蔽的海灣"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bead","explanation":"「bead」在描述手工藝、珠寶或自然現象（如汗珠、露珠）時會出現。在學測中，常出現在描述細節的文學性描寫或日常物品描述中。","senses":[{"sense":"珠子；小圓球（用於裝飾或首飾的圓形小物件）","entries":[{"pattern":"bead","pos":"noun","translation":"珠子","explanation":"指用於製作項鍊或手鍊的圓形小物件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young girl spent the whole afternoon carefully threading colorful <target>beads</target> onto a string to make a bracelet for her mother.","translation":"那個小女孩花了一整個下午，小心地將彩色珠子串在繩子上，為她的母親製作一條手鍊。"},{"sentence":"The expensive necklace was made of rare black <target>beads</target> imported from a distant country in Africa.","translation":"這條昂貴的項鍊是由從非洲遙遠國家進口的稀有黑色珠子製成的。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"pearl","pos":"noun","translation":"珍珠","explanation":"一種特定的天然珠子"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"圓滴；小珠（如汗珠、露珠等液體的小圓球）","entries":[{"pattern":"beads of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"…的圓滴；…珠","explanation":"常用於描述液體（如汗水或露水）形成的小圓球狀。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After running for an hour under the hot sun, <target>beads</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sweat formed on the athlete's forehead.","translation":"在烈日下奔跑一小時後，運動員的額頭上形成了汗珠。"},{"sentence":"Early in the morning, we could see tiny <target>beads</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dew on the green grass of the school playground.","translation":"清晨時分，我們可以在學校操場的綠草地上看到細小的露珠。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"beam","explanation":"「beam」在學測中具有兩種截然不同的語意：一是物理上的「光束」或建築上的「橫樑」，二是表達喜悅的「燦爛笑容」。在閱讀測驗中，區分這兩種語意需依賴上下文，尤其是它作為動詞時，通常與光線或笑容相關。","senses":[{"sense":"光束；橫樑（物理實體）","entries":[{"pattern":"beam of light","pos":"phrase","translation":"一束光線","explanation":"指從單一來源發出的線狀光芒，常見於自然景觀描寫或科技設備描述。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the morning sun rose, a single <pattern>beam</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>light</target> broke through the thick clouds and lit up the valley.","translation":"當早晨的太陽升起時，一束光線穿透了厚厚的雲層，照亮了山谷。"}]},{"pattern":"beam","pos":"noun","translation":"橫樑","explanation":"建築結構中支撐屋頂或天花板的厚木頭或金屬條。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old barn was so decayed that the heavy wooden <target>beams</target> supporting the roof began to crack and bend.","translation":"那座舊穀倉如此腐朽，以至於支撐屋頂的沉重木樑開始裂開並彎曲。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"ray","pos":"noun","translation":"光線","explanation":"指單一的直線光芒"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"燦爛地微笑（表達極大喜悅）","entries":[{"pattern":"beam with joy / pride","pos":"phrase","translation":"欣喜若狂；充滿自豪地微笑","explanation":"動詞用法，描述一個人因為極其開心或自豪而臉上洋溢著笑容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The proud father <target>beamed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> <pattern>pride</pattern> as he watched his daughter receive the gold medal at the graduation ceremony.","translation":"當那位自豪的父親看著女兒在畢業典禮上領到金牌時，他臉上洋溢著自豪的笑容。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grin","pos":"verb","translation":"露齒而笑","explanation":"強調笑容寬廣"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"beamed","past_participle":"beamed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}
