{"headword":"buffalo","explanation":"「buffalo」在學測中主要作為名詞，指一種大型哺乳動物。需注意其單複數形式（buffaloes 或 buffalos），以及在生物類閱讀文章中，它常被用來討論生態平衡或野生動物保護。","senses":[{"sense":"水牛；野牛（大型厚皮哺乳動物）","entries":[{"pattern":"buffalo","pos":"noun","translation":"水牛；野牛","explanation":"指一種體型巨大、有角且強壯的動物，常見於亞洲或北美洲的自然紀錄片中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed to see a huge herd of <target>buffaloes</target> moving slowly across the wide, grassy plains of Africa.","translation":"遊客們驚訝地看到一大群水牛緩慢地穿過非洲寬廣的草原。"},{"sentence":"Ancient Native Americans relied heavily on the <target>buffalo</target> for food, clothing, and shelter during the cold winter months.","translation":"古代北美原住民在寒冷的冬季月份中，高度依賴野牛來獲取食物、衣物和住所。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"bison","pos":"noun","translation":"美洲野牛","explanation":"特別指北美洲特有的野牛種類"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"buffet","explanation":"「buffet」這個字在學測中具有兩種截然不同的讀音與意義。最常見的是指「自助餐」，但它也可以作為動詞，指「反覆敲擊或衝擊」。在閱讀測驗中，看到這個字時應根據上下文判斷它是名詞還是動詞。","senses":[{"sense":"自助餐（一種自我服務的用餐方式）","entries":[{"pattern":"buffet","pos":"noun","translation":"自助餐","explanation":"指一種將食物擺放在長桌上，讓顧客自行選擇並盛盤的用餐形式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Since the hotel provides a free breakfast <target>buffet</target>, we don't need to spend any extra money on food in the morning.","translation":"由於飯店提供免費的早餐自助餐，我們早晨不需要在食物上花額外的錢。"},{"sentence":"The wedding guests enjoyed a lavish seafood <target>buffet</target> with fresh crabs, oysters, and shrimp from all over the world.","translation":"婚禮賓客們享用了一場豪華的海鮮自助餐，裡面有來自世界各地的鮮蟹、牡蠣和蝦子。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"衝擊；敲擊（通常指風、浪或困難的強烈打擊）","entries":[{"pattern":"buffet sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"衝擊某物","explanation":"常用於描述強風或巨浪反覆地拍打或衝擊某個物體，語境通常較為劇烈。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small fishing boat was violently <target>buffeted</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the strong winds and huge waves during the terrible storm.","translation":"在那場可怕的風暴中，那艘小漁船被強風和巨浪劇烈地衝擊。"},{"sentence":"Despite being <target>buffeted</target> <pattern>by</pattern> many failures in his early career, the young artist never gave up on his dreams.","translation":"儘管在職業生涯早期遭受了許多失敗的衝擊，這位年輕的藝術家從未放棄他的夢想。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"strike","pos":"verb","translation":"打擊；敲擊","explanation":"泛指任何形式的打擊"},{"word":"batter","pos":"verb","translation":"連續擊打","explanation":"強調反覆多次的強烈敲擊"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"buffeted","past_participle":"buffeted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bulb","explanation":"「bulb」在學測中常見於兩種截然不同的情境：一是電學相關的「燈泡」，二是植物學相關的「球莖」。學生在閱讀生物或科技類文章時，必須能夠快速分辨這兩種含義。","senses":[{"sense":"燈泡（發光裝置）","entries":[{"pattern":"light bulb","pos":"noun","translation":"燈泡","explanation":"指發光電器中的玻璃球形部分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the room suddenly became dark, my father realized that the light <target>bulb</target> in the ceiling had burned out.","translation":"當房間突然變暗時，我父親意識到天花板上的燈泡燒掉了。"},{"sentence":"Modern LED <target>bulbs</target> use much less energy than traditional ones, making them a better choice for protecting the environment.","translation":"現代的 LED 燈泡比傳統燈泡省電得多，使它們成為保護環境的更好選擇。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"球莖（植物的地下儲藏器官）","entries":[{"pattern":"bulb","pos":"noun","translation":"球莖","explanation":"指某些植物（如鬱金香或百合）在地下儲存營養的球形部位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The gardener carefully planted the flower <target>bulbs</target> in the soil during autumn, waiting for them to bloom in spring.","translation":"園丁在秋天小心地將花球莖種在土壤中，等待它們在春天開花。"},{"sentence":"Tulips are grown from <target>bulbs</target>, which store enough food and water for the plant to survive the cold winter.","translation":"鬱金香是由球莖生長的，球莖為植物儲存了足夠的食物和水，使其能度過寒冷的冬天。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bull","explanation":"「bull」在學測中除了指代雄性牛外，還常在經濟類文章中出現，用來比喻比喻「牛市」（bull market），指股價上漲的趨勢。這是一個高頻的比喻用法，學生應將其與「bear market」（熊市）對比記憶。","senses":[{"sense":"公牛（雄性牛）","entries":[{"pattern":"bull","pos":"noun","translation":"公牛","explanation":"指成年雄性牛。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farm workers were terrified when a powerful <target>bull</target> broke through the wooden fence and ran toward the crowd.","translation":"當一頭強壯的公牛衝破木柵欄並向人群跑來時，，農場工人們感到非常恐懼。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"看漲者；牛市（經濟術語）","entries":[{"pattern":"bull market","pos":"phrase","translation":"牛市；看漲市場","explanation":"比喻公牛頂起股票價格的動作，指股價持續上漲的市場趨勢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many investors believe that we are entering a <target>bull</target> <pattern>market</pattern>, as stock prices have been rising steadily for months.","translation":"許多投資者認為我們正進入一個牛市，因為股價在數月來一直穩步上漲。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[{"word":"bear market","pos":"phrase","translation":"熊市；看跌市場","explanation":"指股價持續下跌的趨勢"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bullet","explanation":"「bullet」在學測中主要作為名詞，指子彈。在閱讀測驗中，它可能出現在犯罪類、歷史類或歷史衝突類文章中。此外，在數位文件編輯中，像「bullet point」這樣的使用方式也常出現在校園生活或報告撰寫指南中。","senses":[{"sense":"子彈（發射物）","entries":[{"pattern":"bullet","pos":"noun","translation":"子彈","explanation":"指從槍械中發射出的金屬零件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police officer carefully checked his gun to make sure there were no <target>bullets</target> left in the chamber.","translation":"警官小心地檢查他的槍，以確保彈藥庫中沒有殘留的子彈。"},{"sentence":"In the old movie, the hero saved the girl by blocking the <target>bullet</target> with his own body, showing his true bravery.","translation":"在舊電影中，英雄用自己的身體擋住了子彈，救了女孩，展現了他的真正的勇敢。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"項目符號（文書處理符號）","entries":[{"pattern":"bullet point","pos":"phrase","translation":"項目符號；列點","explanation":"指在撰寫報告或簡報時，用小圓點或其他符號來列出重點內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Your teacher will give you a higher grade if you organize your presentation slides with clear <target>bullet</target> <pattern>points</pattern> instead of long paragraphs.","translation":"如果你用清晰的項目符號來組織你的簡報投影片，而不是用長段落，老師會給你更高的分數。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bump","explanation":"「bump」在學測中具有多重身分。名詞時可指「碰撞」或「腫塊」，動詞時則指「碰撞」或「偶然遇見」。需注意 bump into sb. 這個片語在閱讀測驗中極高頻，通常用來描述社交情境中的巧合。","senses":[{"sense":"碰撞；腫塊（身體或物體接觸產生的衝擊或腫起）","entries":[{"pattern":"bump","pos":"noun","translation":"碰撞；腫塊","explanation":"指突然的衝擊，或碰撞後皮膚上隆起的腫包。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After falling off his bicycle, the young boy had a large, painful <target>bump</target> on his forehead that stayed red for days.","translation":"從自行車上摔下來後，那個小男孩額頭上起了一個又大又痛的腫包，好幾天都還是紅色的。"},{"sentence":"The car hit a heavy <target>bump</target> in the old country road, causing the passengers to jump up from their seats.","translation":"車子在古老的鄉間道路上撞到一個巨大的凸起，導致乘客們從座位上彈了起来。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"lump","pos":"noun","translation":"腫塊；塊狀物","explanation":"指身體上或物質中不規則的凸起"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"碰撞；偶然遇見（物理上的撞擊或社交上的巧遇）","entries":[{"pattern":"bump into sb.","pos":"phrase","translation":"偶然遇見某人","explanation":"非正式用語，指沒有預約而在街上或公共場所意外見到熟人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I was walking through the crowded shopping mall when I <target>bumped</target> <pattern>into</pattern> my old high school teacher from ten years ago.","translation":"我正走在擁擠的購物中心裡，突然偶然遇見了十年前的高中老師。"},{"sentence":"Imagine my surprise when I <target>bumped</target> <pattern>into</pattern> my cousin at the airport, even though he lived in a different country.","translation":"想像一下我的驚訝程度，儘管我表哥住在不同的國家，我竟然在機場偶然遇見了他。"}]},{"pattern":"bump sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"撞擊某物","explanation":"指輕微地撞到物體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Please be careful not to <target>bump</target> the expensive vase while you are cleaning the dusty shelves in the living room.","translation":"在你清理客廳佈滿灰塵的架子時，請小心不要撞到那個昂貴的花瓶。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"encounter","pos":"verb","translation":"遭遇；邂逅","explanation":"較正式，可用於指遇到困難或意外相遇"},{"word":"collide","pos":"verb","translation":"碰撞","explanation":"強調劇烈的物理撞擊"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bumped","past_participle":"bumped"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bunch","explanation":"「bunch」通常用來描述一群自然生長在一起或被綑綁在一起的人或物。在學測中，常出現在描述花卉、水果（如香蕉）或非正式地描述一群朋友的語境中。","senses":[{"sense":"一串；一束；一群（聚集在一起的東西或人）","entries":[{"pattern":"a bunch of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"一串…；一束…；許多…","explanation":"可用於具體物品（如花、葡萄）或非正式地表示「許多」（等同於 a lot of）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young man bought a beautiful <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> red roses to give to his girlfriend on their first anniversary.","translation":"那個年輕男人買了一束美麗的紅玫瑰，在他們的一週年紀念日送給女朋友。"},{"sentence":"I have a <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> keys in my pocket, but I cannot remember which one opens the back door.","translation":"我口袋裡有一串鑰匙，但我記不起哪一把能打開後門。"},{"sentence":"A <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> excited students gathered around the teacher to ask about the results of the final exam.","translation":"一群興奮的學生聚集在老師周圍，詢問關於期末考結果的事情。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cluster","pos":"noun","translation":"群；簇","explanation":"強調緊密聚集在一起的小組"},{"word":"group","pos":"noun","translation":"組；群","explanation":"最普遍的聚集名詞"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bundle","explanation":"「bundle」的核心概念是「綑綁」。與 bunch 不同，bundle 更多強調透過繩子或帶子將物品強行綑在一起，或指一套打包好的商品/服務。","senses":[{"sense":"捆；束（綑綁在一起的物品）","entries":[{"pattern":"a bundle of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"一捆…；一束…","explanation":"指用繩子或橡皮筋紮起來的物品，如柴火、報紙或鈔票。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farmer spent the whole morning tying a large <target>bundle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dry sticks to start a fire for the winter.","translation":"農夫花了一整個早晨將一大捆乾樹枝紮起來，為了在冬天生火。"},{"sentence":"The detective found a suspicious <target>bundle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cash hidden inside the old wooden desk in the dark office.","translation":"偵探在昏暗辦公室的舊木桌子裡發現了一捆可疑的現金。"}]},{"pattern":"bundle sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"將…綑起來","explanation":"將零散的物品打包成一束。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Before moving to the new house, she <target>bundled</target> all her old newspapers into a neat package for recycling.","translation":"在搬到新家之前，她將所有舊報紙綑成一個整齊的包裹以便回收。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"package","pos":"noun","translation":"包裹","explanation":"泛指包裝起來的物品"},{"word":"stack","pos":"noun","translation":"堆","explanation":"強調垂直堆疊而非綑綁"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"bundled","past_participle":"bundled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bury","explanation":"「bury」除了物理上的「埋葬」外，在學測閱讀中常出現比喻用法，如 bury one's face in...（將臉埋入…）或 bury oneself in work（埋頭於工作），用以表達極度專注或試圖逃避。","senses":[{"sense":"埋葬；掩埋（將某物放入地下或覆蓋）","entries":[{"pattern":"bury sth. in sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"將某物埋在…之中","explanation":"物理上的掩埋，可用於描述動物儲藏食物或掩埋屍體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some squirrels <target>bury</target> their nuts <pattern>in</pattern> the ground during autumn to make sure they have enough food for winter.","translation":"有些松鼠在秋天將堅果埋在地下，以確保冬天有足夠的食物。"},{"sentence":"The heavy snowfall <target>buried</target> the small village <pattern>in</pattern> a thick layer of white ice, making it impossible to leave.","translation":"大雪將這個小村莊掩埋在厚厚的一層白冰之下，讓人無法離開。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"inter","pos":"verb","translation":"埋葬","explanation":"極其正式的用詞，通常指葬禮"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"dig up","pos":"phrase","translation":"挖掘出","explanation":"將埋在地下之物挖出"},{"word":"unearth","pos":"verb","translation":"挖掘；揭露","explanation":"指從地下挖出或揭發隱藏的事實"}]},{"sense":"埋頭於；掩藏（比喻專注或遮掩）","entries":[{"pattern":"bury oneself in sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"埋頭於…；專注於…","explanation":"比喻完全投入於某事，通常是工作、書籍或研究。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To prepare for the difficult entrance exam, the student <target>buried</target> <pattern>himself</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> his textbooks for three months.","translation":"為了準備艱難的入學考試，這名學生三個月來一直埋頭於教科書中。"}]},{"pattern":"bury one's face in sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"將臉埋在…之中","explanation":"常用於表達悲傷、羞愧或極度疲憊。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The girl <target>buried</target> her face <pattern>in</pattern> her hands and started to cry loudly after she failed the music competition.","translation":"在音樂比賽失敗後，女孩將臉埋在雙手中，開始大聲哭泣。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"immerse","pos":"verb","translation":"沉浸於","explanation":"強調完全投入於某種環境或活動"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"buried","past_participle":"buried"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"bush","explanation":"「bush」在自然環境描述中是指低矮且分枝多的灌木。在閱讀測驗中，常與 tree（大樹）做對比，或出現在描述野生動物躲藏的場景中。","senses":[{"sense":"灌木；叢林（低矮且分枝多的植物）","entries":[{"pattern":"bush","pos":"noun","translation":"灌木；叢","explanation":"指比樹矮且由基部就開始分枝的植物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The small rabbit quickly hid behind a thick green <target>bush</target> when it heard the sound of a hungry wolf nearby.","translation":"當小兔子聽到附近有飢餓狼的聲音時，迅速躲在了一叢茂密的綠色灌木後面。"},{"sentence":"My grandmother loves gardening, and she has planted many flowering <target>bushes</target> around the fence of her beautiful backyard.","translation":"我的祖母熱愛園藝，她在她漂亮後院的圍欄周圍種了許多開花灌木。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"shrub","pos":"noun","translation":"灌木","explanation":"與 bush 同義，但稍微更具植物學專業感"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"buzz","explanation":"「buzz」在學測中常出現於兩種截然不同的情境：一是描述環境中持續的嗡嗡聲（如蜜蜂或機器），二是描述社交媒體或校園中對某事的高度關注與熱烈討論。後者在描述趨勢與流行文化時非常高頻。","senses":[{"sense":"嗡嗡聲；持續的低鳴聲（物理上的聲音）","entries":[{"pattern":"buzz","pos":"noun","translation":"嗡嗡聲","explanation":"指蜜蜂、電子設備或人群在背景中產生的持續低頻聲音。","sentences":[{"sentence":"As the summer heat grew, the loud <target>buzz</target> of honeybees in the flower garden became almost impossible to ignore.","translation":"隨著夏季熱氣增加，花園中蜜蜂巨大的嗡嗡聲變得幾乎無法忽視。"},{"sentence":"I could not focus on my reading because of the constant <target>buzz</target> of the old air conditioner in the corner.","translation":"因為角落裡那台舊冷氣機不斷發出的嗡嗡聲，我無法集中精神閱讀。"}]},{"pattern":"buzz","pos":"verb","translation":"發出嗡嗡聲","explanation":"描述物體發出低頻振動聲的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"A small drone <target>buzzed</target> over the park, making a loud noise that frightened the birds and scared the local dogs.","translation":"一架小型無人機在公園上空發出嗡嗡聲盤旋，發出的噪音嚇跑了鳥類並驚嚇了當地的狗。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hum","pos":"verb","translation":"發出低鳴聲","explanation":"指較柔和的持續聲音"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"熱烈討論；興奮感（社交或心理層面的關注）","entries":[{"pattern":"create a buzz","pos":"phrase","translation":"引起熱烈討論；製造話題","explanation":"指某件事物突然受到大眾關注，在網路或校園中傳播迅速。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The new movie trailer created a huge <target>buzz</target> on social media, leading millions of people to watch it within one hour.","translation":"這部新電影的預告片在社群媒體上引起了巨大的熱烈討論，導致數百萬人在一小時內觀看了它。"},{"sentence":"There was a lot of <target>buzz</target> around the new student exchange program, as everyone wanted to know the details of the trip.","translation":"關於新的學生交換計畫有許多熱烈討論，因為每個人都想知道這次旅程的細節。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"excitement","pos":"noun","translation":"興奮感；熱潮","explanation":"指對某事的期待與關注"},{"word":"hype","pos":"noun","translation":"誇大的宣傳；炒作","explanation":"強調透過宣傳製造出的熱潮"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"buzzed","past_participle":"buzzed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cabin","explanation":"「cabin」在學測中通常指兩種空間：一是偏遠地區的小木屋（常出現在自然、旅行類文章中）；二是飛機或船隻的客艙（常出現在旅遊、交通類文章中）。學生需根據上下文區分這兩種完全不同的場景。","senses":[{"sense":"小木屋；簡陋的小屋（通常在森林或山上）","entries":[{"pattern":"cabin","pos":"noun","translation":"小木屋","explanation":"指在偏遠地區建造的簡單住宅，通常由木材製成。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the winter vacation, my family rented a cozy <target>cabin</target> in the mountains to enjoy the snow and fresh air.","translation":"在寒假期間，我的家人在山中租了一間舒適的小木屋，以享受白雪與新鮮空氣。"},{"sentence":"The old forest ranger lived alone in a small wooden <target>cabin</target> far away from the noisy cities and busy roads.","translation":"那位年長的森林管理員獨自住在遠離喧鬧城市與繁忙道路的小木屋中。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cottage","pos":"noun","translation":"鄉間小屋","explanation":"通常指較精緻或較大的鄉間住宅"},{"word":"lodge","pos":"noun","translation":"山莊；小木屋","explanation":"常指用於狩獵或度假的木屋"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"客艙；駕駛室（飛機、船隻或電梯內部的空間）","entries":[{"pattern":"cabin","pos":"noun","translation":"客艙","explanation":"指交通工具內部的乘客乘坐區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The flight attendants walked through the <target>cabin</target> to make sure all passengers had fastened their seat belts before takeoff.","translation":"空服員走過客艙，以確保所有乘客在起飛前都已繫好安全帶。"},{"sentence":"Because the cruise ship was very luxurious, each passenger had a private <target>cabin</target> with a small window facing the sea.","translation":"因為這艘郵輪非常豪華，每位乘客都有一個面向大海的小窗戶私人客艙。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"compartment","pos":"noun","translation":"隔間；客艙","explanation":"指被分隔開的獨立空間"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cable","explanation":"「cable」在學測中主要作為名詞，指物理上的電纜或鋼纜；但在現代科技語境中，它也常出現在「cable TV」等複合詞中。作為動詞時，則指透過電報發送訊息，但在現代英語中較少見。","senses":[{"sense":"電纜；鋼纜（厚實的導線或繩索）","entries":[{"pattern":"cable","pos":"noun","translation":"電纜；鋼纜","explanation":"指傳輸電力或數據的厚實線材。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the heavy storm, a power <target>cable</target> fell from the pole, causing a blackout in the entire neighborhood for three hours.","translation":"在大暴風雨後，一條電源電纜從電線桿上掉落，導致整個社區停電三小時。"},{"sentence":"The workers used a strong steel <target>cable</target> to pull the heavy broken car out of the deep muddy road.","translation":"工人們使用一條強韌的鋼纜將那輛沉重的損壞汽車從深泥路中拉出來。"}]},{"pattern":"cable TV","pos":"phrase","translation":"有線電視","explanation":"指透過電纜傳輸訊號的電視系統。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many young people now prefer streaming services over <target>cable</target> TV because they can watch their favorite shows whenever they want.","translation":"許多年輕人現在比起有線電視更喜歡串流服務，因為他們可以在任何想看的時候觀看最喜歡的節目。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"wire","pos":"noun","translation":"電線；導線","explanation":"指較細的線材"},{"word":"cord","pos":"noun","translation":"電線；繩索","explanation":"指較短的家用電線"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"發電報（較少見，指傳遞訊息）","entries":[{"pattern":"cable sb. sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"以電報告知某人某事","explanation":"因應現代科技，此用法較少見，但仍可能出現在歷史類閱讀文章中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the early twentieth century, people would <target>cable</target> their families in other countries to share urgent news quickly.","translation":"在二十世紀初，人們會透過電報告知國外的家人以快速分享緊急消息。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"message","pos":"verb","translation":"發送訊息","explanation":"現代最普遍的用法"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"cabled","past_participle":"cabled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cafeteria","explanation":"「cafeteria」在校園生活類文章中是基礎核心名詞。其特徵是「自助式」的服務方式，這與一般的 restaurant 區分開來。學生應注意其常搭配的動詞如 have lunch in the cafeteria。","senses":[{"sense":"自助餐廳；食堂","entries":[{"pattern":"cafeteria","pos":"noun","translation":"自助餐廳","explanation":"指學校、公司或醫院等機構內部的自助式餐廳。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the short lunch break, the school <target>cafeteria</target> becomes very noisy because hundreds of students gather there to eat.","translation":"在短暫的午餐時間，學校食堂變得非常嘈雜，因為數百名學生聚集在那裡用餐。"},{"sentence":"The university <target>cafeteria</target> offers a variety of healthy meals, including fresh salads and fruit, to help students maintain their health.","translation":"大學食堂提供多樣化的健康餐點，包括新鮮沙拉和水果，以幫助學生維持健康。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"canteen","pos":"noun","translation":"食堂；餐館","explanation":"英式英語中更常用的詞彙"},{"word":"dining hall","pos":"noun","translation":"餐廳；大食堂","explanation":"常用於大學或寄宿學校"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"campus","explanation":"「campus」在學測中是描述校園環境、教育政策或學生生活的高頻名詞。理解這個字時，要注意它不僅指物理上的建築物，有時也指代整個校區或大學的地理範圍。","senses":[{"sense":"校區；校園","entries":[{"pattern":"campus","pos":"noun","translation":"校區；校園","explanation":"指大學或學院的教學建築物及其周邊環境。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The university <target>campus</target> is famous for its beautiful old trees and large green lawns, making it a perfect place for studying.","translation":"這所大學的校園以其美麗的古樹和大片綠色草坪而聞名，使其成為一個完美的學習場所。"},{"sentence":"To reduce traffic and pollution, the college decided to ban all cars from the <target>campus</target> and encourage students to ride bikes.","translation":"為了減少交通和污染，這所學院決定禁止所有汽車進入校園，並鼓勵學生騎自行車。"}]},{"pattern":"on campus","pos":"phrase","translation":"在校園內","explanation":"固定介系詞搭配，用來描述在校區內發生的事情或居住情況。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many first-year students choose to live <pattern>on</pattern> <target>campus</target> so they can easily access the library and attend classes without commuting.","translation":"許多一年級學生選擇住在校園內，這樣他們可以輕鬆地使用圖書館並參加課程而不需要通勤。"}]},{"pattern":"off campus","pos":"phrase","translation":"在校園外","explanation":"固定介系詞搭配，與 on campus 相反。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some senior students prefer to live <pattern>off</pattern> <target>campus</target> in small apartments, as they want more independence and privacy in their lives.","translation":"一些高年級學生更喜歡住在校園外的小公寓裡，因為他們在生活中想要更多的獨立與隱私。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grounds","pos":"noun","translation":"場地；校園","explanation":"指校園的周邊土地或場地"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"canyon","explanation":"「canyon」常用於描述自然地理景觀，特別是在地理或環境類閱讀中出現。理解其特徵（深、陡峭、由河流切割）有助於在描述性文字中快速定位其意義。","senses":[{"sense":"峽谷（由河流長期侵蝕而形成的大型深谷）","entries":[{"pattern":"canyon","pos":"noun","translation":"峽谷","explanation":"指地形上深且陡峭的谷地，通常有河流在底部流經。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After hiking for three hours, the tourists finally reached the edge of the massive <target>canyon</target>, looking down at the blue river far below.","translation":"在健行三小時後，遊客們終於到達了巨大峽谷的邊緣，俯視著下方遙遠的藍色河流。"},{"sentence":"The Grand <target>Canyon</target> in the United States is famous worldwide for its colorful rock layers that show millions of years of history.","translation":"美國的大峽谷以其展示數百萬年歷史的彩色岩層而聞名於世。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"gorge","pos":"noun","translation":"深谷；峽谷","explanation":"通常指較窄且陡峭的峽谷"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"capable","explanation":"「capable」在學測中常用於描述人的能力或事物的潛力。最關鍵的考點在於其後方必須接介系詞 to be able to 的替代結構 capable of + V-ing，這是文法選擇題的高頻考點。","senses":[{"sense":"有能力的；能勝任的","entries":[{"pattern":"be capable of sth./doing sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"有能力做某事","explanation":"重點在於 of 後方必須使用動名詞 (V-ing) 或名詞，不能接不定式 (to V)。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Despite her young age, the student is <pattern>be</pattern> <target>capable</target> <pattern>of</pattern> solving the most difficult math problems in the textbook.","translation":"儘管年紀尚小，這名學生有能力解決課本中最困難的數學問題。"},{"sentence":"Modern computers are <target>capable</target> <pattern>of</pattern> processing millions of pieces of information in just a few seconds.","translation":"現代電腦有能力在短短幾秒鐘內處理數百萬條資訊。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"able","pos":"adjective","translation":"能夠；有能力的","explanation":"最基礎的同義詞，搭配 be able to"},{"word":"competent","pos":"adjective","translation":"勝任的；合格的","explanation":"強調具備必要的專業技能"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"incapable","pos":"adjective","translation":"沒有能力的","explanation":"加上字首 in- 表示否定"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 cap (拿、握) + 形容詞字尾 -able (能夠…的)","related":[{"word":"capability","pos":"noun","translation":"能力；才能","explanation":"由 capable 延伸而來的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"captain","explanation":"「captain」根據情境可指軍事、體育或交通工具的領導者。在閱讀中，應根據上下文判斷其具體職位。","senses":[{"sense":"隊長；船長；機長（組織或交通工具的領導者）","entries":[{"pattern":"captain","pos":"noun","translation":"隊長；船長；機長","explanation":"泛指在特定領域（如體育隊、飛機、船隻）中擁有最高權限的領導者。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The basketball <target>captain</target> encouraged his teammates to keep fighting even though they were losing the game.","translation":"籃球隊長鼓勵他的隊友們即使在比賽落後時也要繼續奮鬥。"},{"sentence":"The <target>captain</target> of the airplane calmly told the passengers that the flight would be delayed due to bad weather.","translation":"飛機機長冷靜地告訴乘客，航班將因為天氣惡劣而延誤。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"leader","pos":"noun","translation":"領導者","explanation":"最泛用的領導者稱呼"},{"word":"commander","pos":"noun","translation":"指揮官","explanation":"常用於軍事背景"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"capture","explanation":"「capture」在學測中具有「物理上的捕捉」與「抽象上的捕捉/記錄」兩種高頻語意。後者常用於描述攝影、藝術或數據記錄，是閱讀理解的關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"捕捉；捕獲（物理上的抓捕）","entries":[{"pattern":"capture sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉某物","explanation":"指將動物或嫌疑犯強行限制在某個空間內。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The animal rescue team worked together to <target>capture</target> the lost tiger without hurting the animal.","translation":"動物救援隊共同合作，在不傷害動物的情況下捕捉到了那隻迷路的老虎。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"catch","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉","explanation":"最基礎的捕捉動詞"},{"word":"seize","pos":"verb","translation":"奪取；抓捕","explanation":"強調用力、快速地抓取"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"release","pos":"verb","translation":"釋放","explanation":"指將捕捉到的對象釋放"}]},{"sense":"記錄；捕捉（抽象的瞬間或情感）","entries":[{"pattern":"capture sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"捕捉（瞬間、情感、美景）","explanation":"常用於攝影、繪畫或寫作，指將某個瞬間或感覺記錄下來。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young photographer used a high-speed camera to <target>capture</target> the exact moment the bird flew away.","translation":"年輕的攝影師使用高速相機捕捉到了鳥兒飛走的精確瞬間。"},{"sentence":"Her latest novel successfully <target>captures</target> the lonely feelings of teenagers who live in a big, crowded city.","translation":"她最新的小說成功捕捉到了居住在大城市中青少年的孤獨感。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"record","pos":"verb","translation":"記錄","explanation":"指用工具將資訊記錄下來"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"俘虜；捕獲物","entries":[{"pattern":"capture","pos":"noun","translation":"捕獲；俘虜","explanation":"指被捕獲的過程或結果。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The <target>capture</target> of the dangerous criminal was a great victory for the local police department.","translation":"那名危險罪犯的被捕獲是當地警察局的一次重大勝利。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"captured","past_participle":"captured"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"captive","pos":"adjective","translation":"被俘虜的","explanation":"指處於被捕捉狀態的人或動物。"}]}}

{"headword":"career","explanation":"「career」與 job 或 profession 不同，它強調的是一個人在一生中長期經營的職業生涯或發展路徑。在學測中常用於探討職涯發展、個人成長與人生目標。","senses":[{"sense":"職業生涯；職涯","entries":[{"pattern":"career","pos":"noun","translation":"職業生涯","explanation":"指一個人從開始工作到退休的整段過程，而非單一的一份工作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After studying hard for four years in college, Sarah decided to pursue a <target>career</target> in international law.","translation":"在大學努力學習四年後， Sarah 決定追求在國際法方面的職業生涯。"},{"sentence":"The famous scientist spent his entire <target>career</target> searching for a cure for the rare disease.","translation":"那名著名的科學家花了他整個職業生涯來尋找治療這種罕見疾病的方法。"}]},{"pattern":"career path","pos":"phrase","translation":"職涯路徑","explanation":"指職業發展的具體方向和階段。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many high school students feel lost because they do not know which <target>career</target> <pattern>path</pattern> is best for them.","translation":"許多高中生感到迷茫，因為他們不知道哪條職涯路徑對他們最適合。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"profession","pos":"noun","translation":"專業職業","explanation":"強調需要專業知識或長時間訓練的職業"},{"word":"vocation","pos":"noun","translation":"天職；召喚","explanation":"強調對職業的強烈內在驅動力"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"carpenter","explanation":"「carpenter」在學測中通常出現在描述職業或家庭修繕的文本中。理解這個字時，應將其與其工作對象（木材）以及相關工具（如鋸子、錘子）聯繫起來，以強化記憶。","senses":[{"sense":"木工；木匠（從事木材加工的專業人員）","entries":[{"pattern":"carpenter","pos":"noun","translation":"木匠","explanation":"指專業使用木材建造房屋或製作家具的工匠。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old <target>carpenter</target> spent years carefully crafting a beautiful wooden table for his daughter's wedding gift.","translation":"那位老木匠花了好幾年時間，為他女兒的婚禮禮物精心製作了一張漂亮的木桌。"},{"sentence":"If the kitchen door is broken, we should call a professional <target>carpenter</target> to fix the frame and ensure it closes properly.","translation":"如果廚房門壞了，我們應該請一位專業的木匠來修理門框，並確保它能正常關閉。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"woodworker","pos":"noun","translation":"木工人員","explanation":"泛指所有處理木材的人"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"核心字根 carpenter (木匠) + 名詞字尾 -er (人)","related":[{"word":"carpentry","pos":"noun","translation":"木工活；木工技術","explanation":"由 carpenter 延伸而來的專業技術名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"carpet","explanation":"「carpet」在學測中除了作為名詞表示「地毯」外，還能作為動詞表示「鋪地毯」。在閱讀中，要注意其在句子中的位置，以判斷其詞性與語意。","senses":[{"sense":"地毯（鋪在地面上的厚布料）","entries":[{"pattern":"carpet","pos":"noun","translation":"地毯","explanation":"指鋪在地板上的大型厚織物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hotel room had a soft, red <target>carpet</target> that made the floor feel warm and comfortable during the cold winter.","translation":"飯店房間裡有一塊柔軟的紅色地毯，讓地板在寒冷的冬天感覺溫暖且舒適。"},{"sentence":"After the party, the host had to spend an hour cleaning the spilled red wine from the expensive <target>carpet</target> in the living room.","translation":"派對結束後，主人不得不花一個小時將客廳昂貴地毯上灑出的紅酒清理乾淨。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"rug","pos":"noun","translation":"小地毯","explanation":"通常指尺寸較小、不固定在地面上的地毯"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"鋪地毯；覆蓋（像地毯一樣覆蓋整個表面）","entries":[{"pattern":"carpet sth. with sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"用…鋪滿某處","explanation":"動詞用法，指用某物將整個表面完全覆蓋，常出現在自然景觀描寫中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In early spring, the gentle rain and warm sun <target>carpeted</target> the forest floor <pattern>with</pattern> a thick layer of colorful wildflowers.","translation":"早春時分，溫暖的陽光與細雨將森林地面鋪滿了一層厚厚的五彩繽紛的野花。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cover","pos":"verb","translation":"覆蓋","explanation":"最普遍的覆蓋動作"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"carpeted","past_participle":"carpeted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"carriage","explanation":"「carriage」在學測中具有兩種截然不同的高頻語意：一是歷史背景下的「馬車/車廂」，二是生理上的「姿態/風度」。學生應根據上下文（如 horses, station, posture）來快速區分。","senses":[{"sense":"馬車；車廂（交通工具或其一部分）","entries":[{"pattern":"carriage","pos":"noun","translation":"馬車；車廂","explanation":"指由馬匹牽引的車輛或火車的客車車廂。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the nineteenth century, wealthy families often traveled by horse-drawn <target>carriage</target> to visit their friends in the nearby city.","translation":"在十九世紀，富裕家庭經常乘坐馬車前往附近的城市拜訪朋友。"},{"sentence":"The train station was very crowded, and it took me ten minutes to find the correct <target>carriage</target> for my seat.","translation":"火車站非常擁擠，我花了十分鐘才找到我座位所在的正確車廂。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"coach","pos":"noun","translation":"長途客車；車廂","explanation":"常用於火車或馬車的舒適車廂"},{"word":"wagon","pos":"noun","translation":"貨車；馬車","explanation":"通常指較簡單、用來載貨的車輛"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"姿態；風度（身體站立或行走時的樣子）","entries":[{"pattern":"carriage","pos":"noun","translation":"姿態；風度","explanation":"指一個人站立、行走或坐著時的身體樣子，等同於 posture。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The ballet dancer's elegant <target>carriage</target> made her look like a queen even before she started to dance on the stage.","translation":"那位芭蕾舞者的優雅姿態，讓她在舞台上開始跳舞之前就看起來像一位女王。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"posture","pos":"noun","translation":"姿勢；體態","explanation":"指身體的物理位置"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"來自動詞 carry (攜帶、運送) + 名詞字尾 -age","related":[{"word":"carrier","pos":"noun","translation":"運送者；載體","explanation":"指運送物品或傳播疾病的的人或物。"}]}}

{"headword":"cart","explanation":"「cart」在學測中主要作為名詞表示「推車/貨車」，但在現代英語中，其動詞用法（如 cart away）常出現在描述清理或搬運的語境中。","senses":[{"sense":"推車；小貨車（用來運送物品的簡單車輛）","entries":[{"pattern":"cart","pos":"noun","translation":"手推車；小貨車","explanation":"指用來運送貨物的簡單車輛，可以是手推的或由動物牽引的。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The farmer used a wooden <target>cart</target> to move the heavy bags of corn from the field to the barn.","translation":"農夫使用一台木製的小貨車將沉重的玉米袋從田野運到穀倉。"},{"sentence":"When I go to the supermarket, I always take a shopping <target>cart</target> so that I can buy more groceries for my family.","translation":"當我去超市時，我總是拿一台購物車，這樣我我可以為家人買更多雜貨。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"trolley","pos":"noun","translation":"手推車","explanation":"英式英語常用詞"},{"word":"wagon","pos":"noun","translation":"貨車","explanation":"較大型的運貨車"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"運送；搬運（通常指搬運沉重或不便的物品）","entries":[{"pattern":"cart sth. away","pos":"phrase","translation":"將某物運走","explanation":"動詞搭配，強調搬運沉重的物品離開現場。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the storm, the city workers had to <target>cart</target> the fallen trees <pattern>away</pattern> to keep the roads clear.","translation":"風暴過後，城市工人不得不將倒下的樹木運走，以保持道路暢通。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"transport","pos":"verb","translation":"運輸；運送","explanation":"更正式的運送方式"},{"word":"haul","pos":"verb","translation":"用力拖運","explanation":"強調搬運過程的辛苦"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"carted","past_participle":"carted"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cigarette","explanation":"「cigarette」在健康、社會議題類閱讀中是高頻名詞。重點在於它常與禁菸區、健康警示或成癮行為相關的搭配詞（collocation）一起出現。","senses":[{"sense":"香菸","entries":[{"pattern":"smoke a cigarette","pos":"phrase","translation":"抽菸","explanation":"最基礎的動賓搭配，描述抽菸的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The old man sat quietly on the wooden bench, slowly <target>smoking</target> a <pattern>cigarette</pattern> while watching the sunset over the ocean.","translation":"老人靜靜地坐在木凳上，緩慢地抽著菸，看著海邊的日落。"}]},{"pattern":"cigarette smoke","pos":"noun","translation":"菸煙","explanation":"複合名詞，指抽菸產生的煙霧，常出現在環境污染或健康討論中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the room was small and poorly ventilated, the thick <target>cigarette</target> <pattern>smoke</pattern> made it very hard for the students to breathe.","translation":"因為房間狹小且通風不良，濃厚的菸煙讓學生們感到呼吸困難。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cinema","explanation":"「cinema」在描述休閒活動、文化藝術或電影工業時使用。在美式英語中，通常使用 theater，但在學測閱讀中兩者通用，需注意其指代「電影院」或「電影藝術」兩種語意。","senses":[{"sense":"電影院（放映電影的場所）","entries":[{"pattern":"go to the cinema","pos":"phrase","translation":"去電影院","explanation":"固定搭配，指前往電影院觀看電影的社交活動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After finishing all their homework on Friday night, the teenagers decided to <pattern>go</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> the <target>cinema</target> to see the latest superhero movie.","translation":"週五晚上完成所有作業後，青少年們決定去電影院看最新的超級英雄電影。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"movie theater","pos":"noun","translation":"電影院","explanation":"美式英語常用詞"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"電影（作為一種藝術形式或工業）","entries":[{"pattern":"the cinema","pos":"noun","translation":"電影藝術；電影工業","explanation":"指電影作為一種媒介或文化產物，而非單一的建築物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The professor's lecture focused on how early <target>cinema</target> changed the way people perceived time and space in the late nineteenth century.","translation":"教授的講座聚焦於早期電影如何改變了十九世紀末人們感知時間與空間的方式。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"film","pos":"noun","translation":"電影；影片","explanation":"較為正式的說法"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"circus","explanation":"「circus」在學測中通常出現在描述傳統娛樂、動物權利或文化遺產的閱讀測驗中。理解此字時，應將其與表演者（如 acrobats, clowns）聯繫起來。","senses":[{"sense":"馬戲團；馬戲表演","entries":[{"pattern":"a circus","pos":"noun","translation":"馬戲團","explanation":"指表演團體或其演出場所。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The children were excited to see the <target>circus</target> perform in the city park, where they saw amazing acrobats and funny clowns.","translation":"孩子們很興奮看到馬戲團在城市公園演出，在那裡他們看到了令人驚嘆的特技演員和滑稽的小丑。"},{"sentence":"Many people now <target>object</target> to the use of wild animals in the <pattern>circus</pattern>, arguing that it is cruel to keep them in cages.","translation":"現在許多人反對在馬戲團中使用野生動物，認為將牠們關在籠子裡是很殘忍的。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"citizen","explanation":"「citizen」是公民社會、法律權利與全球化議題中的核心詞彙。在學測中，常與 rights (權利), duties (義務) 或 global (全球) 搭配，形成對比或論述。","senses":[{"sense":"公民；國民（具有某國法律身分的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"a citizen of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"…的公民","explanation":"用來界定某人的國籍或法律身分。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After living in Canada for ten years and passing the language test, the immigrant finally became a <target>citizen</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the country.","translation":"在加拿大居住十年並通過語言測試後，這名移民終於成為該國的公民。"}]},{"pattern":"global citizen","pos":"phrase","translation":"全球公民","explanation":"高頻寫作詞彙，指具有全球視野、關注國際問題的人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school encourages students to become <target>citizens</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the world by learning foreign languages and studying different cultures.","translation":"學校鼓勵學生透過學習外語和研究不同文化來成為全球公民。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"national","pos":"noun","translation":"國民","explanation":"強調法律上的國籍身分"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"alien","pos":"noun","translation":"外國人；外來者","explanation":"指非該國公民的人"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 cit (呼喚、召集) + 字尾 -izen","related":[{"word":"citizenship","pos":"noun","translation":"公民權；公民身分","explanation":"由 citizen 加上名詞字尾 -ship 延伸而來。"},{"word":"civic","pos":"adjective","translation":"公民的；城市的","explanation":"與 citizen 同源，指與公民責任相關的。"}]}}

{"headword":"civil","explanation":"「civil」在學測中具有多重義項，最常見的是與「公民」或「平民」相關的法律、權利討論，以及描述人的「文明/有禮貌」程度。區分其「法律/行政」面與「社交/禮貌」面是解題關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"公民的；民事的（與軍事或刑事相對）","entries":[{"pattern":"civil rights","pos":"phrase","translation":"公民權利","explanation":"指法律賦予所有公民的平等權利，常用於討論社會正義、平等或歷史運動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the mid-twentieth century, many brave leaders fought hard to protect the <pattern>civil</pattern> <target>rights</target> of all minority groups.","translation":"在二十世紀中期，許多勇敢的領袖努力爭取保護所有少數群體的公民權利。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 civ (公民)","related":[{"word":"civilize","pos":"verb","translation":"使文明化","explanation":"使一個社會具備文明的特徵。"},{"word":"civilization","pos":"noun","translation":"文明","explanation":"人類社會的高度發展狀態。"},{"word":"civility","pos":"noun","translation":"有禮貌；文明","explanation":"指社交上的禮貌與文明行為。"}]}}

{"headword":"closet","explanation":"「closet」在學測中主要作為名詞，指室內的小房間或儲藏室。此外，它在比喻義中可用於描述「秘密的」狀態（如 closet fan 或 closet optimist），但對於 GSAT 學生而言，優先記憶其物理空間的含義。","senses":[{"sense":"儲藏室；衣櫥（用於存放物品的小空間）","entries":[{"pattern":"closet","pos":"noun","translation":"儲藏室；衣櫥","explanation":"指室內一個專門用來存放衣服或雜物的小房間或櫃子。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the flood, the family moved all their expensive electronics into the top <target>closet</target> to keep them safe and dry.","translation":"洪水之後，這家人將所有昂貴的電子產品移到頂層儲藏室中，以確保它們安全且乾燥。"},{"sentence":"My sister spent an hour organizing her <target>closet</target>, sorting through old clothes that she no longer wears.","translation":"我姊姊花了一小時整理她的衣櫥，對那些她不再穿的舊衣服進行分類。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"cupboard","pos":"noun","translation":"櫥櫃","explanation":"通常指廚房或儲藏室的櫃子"},{"word":"wardrobe","pos":"noun","translation":"衣櫥","explanation":"通常指獨立的衣櫃"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"clothe","explanation":"「clothe」是一個動詞，意為「提供衣服」。學生常將其與名詞 clothes (衣服) 或形容詞 clothing (服裝) 混淆。注意其發音與拼寫，特別是在作為動詞時的用法。","senses":[{"sense":"給…穿衣；為…提供衣服","entries":[{"pattern":"clothe sb. in sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"讓某人穿上…","explanation":"描述某人被賦予特定的服裝，常用於描述歷史背景或特定社會階級的服裝。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the old movie, the rich king was <target>clothed</target> <pattern>in</pattern> expensive gold silk and heavy jewelry to show his power.","translation":"在舊電影中，富有的國王穿著昂貴的金絲綢和沉重的珠寶，以展示他的權力。"},{"sentence":"The charity organization works hard to <target>clothe</target> homeless people during the cold winter months to prevent them from freezing.","translation":"慈善組織努力在寒冷的冬季為無家可歸者提供衣服，以防止他們被凍僵。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"dress","pos":"verb","translation":"穿衣","explanation":"最常用的穿衣動詞"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"clothed","past_participle":"clothed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"clothes","pos":"noun","translation":"衣服","explanation":"clothe 的名詞型態，指具體的衣服。"},{"word":"clothing","pos":"noun","translation":"服裝","explanation":"集合名詞，指服裝這類物品。"}]}}

{"headword":"clown","explanation":"「clown」在學測中主要作為名詞指「小丑」，但在某些語境中，它可用於比喻義，指稱那些行為舉止像小丑一樣滑稽、愚蠢的人。作為動詞時，則指「裝傻」或「做滑稽動作」。","senses":[{"sense":"小丑；滑稽演員","entries":[{"pattern":"clown","pos":"noun","translation":"小丑","explanation":"指在馬戲團或派對上表演的專業演員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The children laughed loudly when the <target>clown</target> accidentally tripped over his own oversized shoes and fell on the floor.","translation":"當小丑不小心被自己巨大的鞋子絆到並摔在地上時，孩子們大聲地笑了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"jester","pos":"noun","translation":"宮廷小丑","explanation":"指古代宮廷中的滑稽演員"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"愚蠢的人（比喻義）","entries":[{"pattern":"be a clown","pos":"phrase","translation":"像小丑一樣（愚蠢、好笑）","explanation":"用於描述某人為了吸引注意力而做出愚蠢的行為。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Stop <target>clowning</target> around in the library and focus on your studies, or the teacher will send you out.","translation":"別在圖書館裡裝傻搞怪了，專注於你的學習，否則老師會把你趕出去。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fool","pos":"noun","translation":"傻瓜","explanation":"指行為愚蠢的人"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"裝傻；做滑稽動作","entries":[{"pattern":"clown around","pos":"phrase","translation":"裝傻；搞怪","explanation":"常用於描述某人故意做出滑稽動作以逗笑他人。","sentences":[{"sentence":"During the school play, the lead actor started to <target>clown</target> <pattern>around</pattern> to make the nervous audience feel more relaxed.","translation":"在學校演出中，，主演開始裝傻搞怪，好讓緊張的觀眾感到更放鬆。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"joke","pos":"verb","translation":"開玩笑","explanation":"指用言語或動作做出滑稽事"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"clowned","past_participle":"clowned"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"clue","explanation":"「clue」在學測中是核心名詞，常用於偵探故事、科學研究或解決問題的線索。學生應掌握其在否定句中表示「完全沒有頭緒」的用法（如 have no clue），這是高頻考點。","senses":[{"sense":"線索；提示（解決問題的關鍵資訊）","entries":[{"pattern":"clue","pos":"noun","translation":"線索","explanation":"指解決問題或發現真相的資訊。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The police found a small piece of blue fabric as a <target>clue</target> at the crime scene to find the thief.","translation":"警方在犯罪現場發現了一塊藍色布料作為線索，用以尋找小偷。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave the students a small <target>clue</target> to help them solve the difficult math problem in the exam.","translation":"老師給了學生一個小提示，好幫助他們在考試中解決那個困難的數學題目。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hint","pos":"noun","translation":"提示；暗示","explanation":"指較小、較間接的提示"},{"word":"evidence","pos":"noun","translation":"證據","explanation":"指較正式且具備證明力的資訊"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"頭緒；了解","entries":[{"pattern":"have no clue","pos":"phrase","translation":"完全沒有頭緒；完全不知道","explanation":"口語中極其高頻，等同於 have no idea。常用於表達對某事完全不了解。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I <target>have</target> <pattern>no</pattern> <target>clue</target> where the new student from Japan came from, because I have never met him before.","translation":"我完全沒有頭緒新來的日本學生是從哪裡來的，因為我之前從未見過他。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"idea","pos":"noun","translation":"頭緒；主意","explanation":" "}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"announce","explanation":"「announce」在學測中常用於正式場合，如政府公告、學校通知或公司聲明。要注意其名詞形式「announcement」在考題中經常作為受詞，表示被公告的具體內容。","senses":[{"sense":"宣布；公告（正式地向大眾告知某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"announce sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"宣布某事","explanation":"及物動詞，直接接宣布的事項，通常是決定、計畫或結果。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The school principal will <target>announce</target> the winners of the annual science competition during the assembly tomorrow morning.","translation":"校長將在明天早上的集會中宣布年度科學競賽的獲勝者。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <target>announce</target> its new product line to the public through a large press conference.","translation":"公司決定透過一場大型記者會向大眾宣布其新產品線。"}]},{"pattern":"announce that...","pos":"phrase","translation":"宣布…（後接子句）","explanation":"後接名詞子句，用來詳細說明宣布的具體內容，是寫作中最常用的結構。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The government <target>announced</target> <pattern>that</pattern> all public transportation would be free for citizens during the holiday weekend.","translation":"政府宣布在假期週末期間，所有公共交通對公民免費。"},{"sentence":"The airline <target>announced</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the flight to New York was delayed due to a sudden heavy snowstorm.","translation":"航空公司宣布前往紐約的航班因突然的強大暴風雪而延誤。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"declare","pos":"verb","translation":"宣告；聲明","explanation":"語氣比 announce 更強，通常帶有權威性或法律效力"},{"word":"proclaim","pos":"verb","translation":"公告；宣稱","explanation":"正式且莊重地向大眾宣布，常用於歷史或政治語境"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"announced","past_participle":"announced"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 nounce (報告、宣布) + 字首 an- (強化)","related":[{"word":"announcement","pos":"noun","translation":"公告；宣布","explanation":"由 announce 加上名詞字尾 -ment 形成。"},{"word":"pronounce","pos":"verb","translation":"發音；宣判","explanation":"字首 pro- (向前) + nounce (說)，字面意為向前說出。"}]}}

{"headword":"anyhow","explanation":"「anyhow」在學測中主要作為副詞，用來轉換話題或在論述中加入補充說明。它具有「無論如何」或「反正」的口語色彩，在閱讀理解中常作為邏輯轉折的信號字。","senses":[{"sense":"無論如何；反正（用於補充理由或在不確定情況下得出結論）","entries":[{"pattern":"anyhow","pos":"adverb","translation":"無論如何；反正","explanation":"通常置於句首或句尾，用來表示即使之前的論點不成立，現在這個理由依然有效。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I forgot to bring my umbrella, but it stopped raining <target>anyhow</target>, so I didn't get wet on my way home.","translation":"我忘了帶傘，但反正後來雨停了，所以我回家路上沒有淋濕。"},{"sentence":"The hotel was a bit too expensive for us, but we decided to book it <target>anyhow</target> because it was the last room.","translation":"那家飯店對我們來說有點太貴，但因為那是最後一間房，我們無論如何還是決定訂房。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"anyway","pos":"adverb","translation":"無論如何；反正","explanation":"與 anyhow 幾乎完全相同，但在書面語中更常用"},{"word":"regardless","pos":"adverb","translation":"不論如何","explanation":"強調不考慮任何障礙或限制而採取行動"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"any (任何) + how (方式)","related":[]}}

{"headword":"apart","explanation":"「apart」在學測中常出現在描述物理距離或情感關係的語境中。特別要注意片語「set apart」和「take apart」，這兩個片語在閱讀測驗中具有完全不同的抽象意義。","senses":[{"sense":"分開的；相距的（物理空間上的分離）","entries":[{"pattern":"apart","pos":"adverb","translation":"分開地；相距地","explanation":"描述兩個或多個物體之間存在空間距離。","sentences":[{"sentence":"To ensure the safety of the plants, the gardener placed the small flower pots three inches <target>apart</target> from each other.","translation":"為了確保植物的安全，園丁將小花盆彼此相距三英吋放置。"},{"sentence":"The two houses were built so far <target>apart</target> that the neighbors could hardly see each other across the wide road.","translation":"這兩棟房子蓋得如此遙遠，以至於鄰居們幾乎看不見對面寬馬路另一邊的人。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"separate","pos":"adjective","translation":"分開的","explanation":"強調獨立且不相連"},{"word":"distant","pos":"adjective","translation":"遙遠的","explanation":"強調空間上的距離"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"together","pos":"adverb","translation":"在一起","explanation":"物理上或邏輯上的結合"}]},{"sense":"拆卸；區分（將整體分解或將某物與眾不同）","entries":[{"pattern":"take sth. apart","pos":"phrase","translation":"拆卸某物","explanation":"指將機器或結構分解成零件。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The curious boy decided to <target>take</target> his old alarm clock <pattern>apart</pattern> to see how the small gears worked inside.","translation":"好奇的男孩決定拆開他的舊鬧鐘，看看裡面的小齒輪是如何運作的。"}]},{"pattern":"set sb./sth. apart","pos":"phrase","translation":"使…與眾不同","explanation":"抽象意義，指某項特質讓某人或某物在人群中顯得突出。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Her amazing ability to speak five different languages <target>set</target> her <pattern>apart</pattern> from all the other candidates for the job.","translation":"她能說五種不同語言的驚人能力，使她在所有應徵該職位的候選人中脫穎而出。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"distinguish","pos":"verb","translation":"區分；辨別","explanation":"指辨識出兩者之間的差異"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字首 a- (在...方向) + part (部分)","related":[]}}

{"headword":"apologize","explanation":"「apologize」是社交情境的核心動詞。在學測中，最關鍵的考點是介系詞的搭配：對「人」用 to，對「事」用 for。","senses":[{"sense":"道歉（對自己的錯誤或造成的不便表示遺憾）","entries":[{"pattern":"apologize to sb. for sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"因某事向某人道歉","explanation":"這是最完整的搭配模式。to 後接道歉的對象，for 後接道歉的原因（名詞或 V-ing）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After accidentally breaking the expensive vase, the young girl quickly <target>apologized</target> <pattern>to</pattern> her mother <pattern>for</pattern> her carelessness.","translation":"在不小心打破昂貴花瓶後，小女孩趕快因為自己的粗心而向母親道歉。"},{"sentence":"The company representative <target>apologized</target> <pattern>to</pattern> all the customers <pattern>for</pattern> the technical problems that caused the website to crash.","translation":"公司代表就導致網站崩潰的技術問題向所有客戶道歉。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"say sorry","pos":"phrase","translation":"道歉","explanation":"較口語且非正式的表達方式"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"apologized","past_participle":"apologized"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 polo (對抗、辯論) + 字尾 -ize (使...化)","related":[{"word":"apology","pos":"noun","translation":"道歉；道歉信","explanation":"由動詞 apologize 轉換而來的名詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"award","explanation":"「award」在學測中常以名詞與動詞兩種形式出現。作為動詞時，它強調「正式地授予」某項榮譽或金錢；作為名詞時，則是指該「獎項」本身。學生應注意其與 give 或 prize 的區別：award 更強調程序上的正式性。","senses":[{"sense":"授予；頒發（正式地給予獎項、獎金或決定）","entries":[{"pattern":"award sb. sth.","pos":"verb","translation":"授予某人某物","explanation":"及物動詞，後接授予對象與授予內容，常用於描述學術成就、體育比賽或法律裁決。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The committee decided to <target>award</target> the young scientist <pattern>a</pattern> full scholarship because of her impressive research on solar energy.","translation":"委員會決定授予這位年輕科學家全額獎學金，因為她對太陽能的研究令人印象深刻。"},{"sentence":"After a long and difficult game, the judges <target>awarded</target> the gold medal <pattern>to</pattern> the runner who finished the race first.","translation":"在一場漫長且艱難的比賽後，評審將金牌頒發給了首先完成比賽的跑者。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grant","pos":"verb","translation":"授予；准許","explanation":"通常指正式地給予權利或資金"},{"word":"bestow","pos":"verb","translation":"贈與；賜予","explanation":"語氣較正式，常指授予高尚的榮譽"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"獎項；獎勵（正式授予的物品或榮譽）","entries":[{"pattern":"win / receive an award","pos":"phrase","translation":"獲得獎項","explanation":"名詞用法，指獲得具體的獎杯、獎金或榮譽證書。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The novelist was extremely proud when she <pattern>won</pattern> a prestigious <target>award</target> for the best historical book of the year.","translation":"這位小說家在贏得年度最佳歷史書籍的享有盛名的獎項時感到非常自豪。"},{"sentence":"The high school students worked together for months to <pattern>receive</pattern> an <target>award</target> for their creative environmental project.","translation":"高中生們合作數月，以獲得他們創意環保專案的獎項。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"prize","pos":"noun","translation":"獎品；獎金","explanation":"泛指比賽中贏得的物品"},{"word":"honor","pos":"noun","translation":"榮譽","explanation":"強調精神上的認可"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"awarded","past_participle":"awarded"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awardee","pos":"noun","translation":"獲獎者","explanation":"由 award 加上受詞字尾 -ee 構成。"}]}}

{"headword":"aware","explanation":"「aware」是一個極其高頻的形容詞，核心意義是「意識到」或「知道」。在學測中，它最常出現在 be aware of sth. 這一片語結構中。學生應將其與 conscious 區分，aware 通常指對外部資訊的覺察，而 conscious 則更多指意識清醒或內在的覺知。","senses":[{"sense":"意識到；知道（察覺到某事的存在或事實）","entries":[{"pattern":"be aware of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"意識到某事","explanation":"最核心的搭配，of 後方接名詞或名詞子句，描述察覺到的對象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many people are not <target>aware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the dangerous effects that plastic waste has on the deep ocean environment.","translation":"許多人沒有意識到塑料廢物對深海環境產生的危險影響。"},{"sentence":"The students were well <target>aware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the strict rules in the library and kept their voices very low.","translation":"學生們非常清楚圖書館的嚴格規定，因此將聲音壓得很低。"}]},{"pattern":"be aware that...","pos":"phrase","translation":"意識到…（後接子句）","explanation":"後接 that 子句，用來詳細說明意識到的具體內容。","sentences":[{"sentence":"You should be <target>aware</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the train schedule changes during the summer, so please check the time again.","translation":"你應該意識到火車時刻表在夏天會變動，所以請再次檢查時間。"},{"sentence":"The teacher was <target>aware</target> <pattern>that</pattern> some students were struggling with the difficult math problems and offered extra help.","translation":"老師意識到有些學生在處理困難的數學問題時很吃力，因此提供了額外幫助。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"conscious","pos":"adjective","translation":"有意識的；覺察的","explanation":"強調對周圍環境或內在狀態的覺知"},{"word":"mindful","pos":"adjective","translation":"留心的；注意的","explanation":"強調刻意地關注某事"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unaware","pos":"adjective","translation":"未意識到的；不知道的","explanation":"aware 的反義詞，直接加上前綴 un-"},{"word":"ignorant","pos":"adjective","translation":"無知的；不知道的","explanation":"指缺乏知識或資訊"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awareness","pos":"noun","translation":"意識；覺悟","explanation":"由形容詞 aware 加上名詞字尾 -ness 構成。"}]}}

{"headword":"awful","explanation":"「awful」在口語中常用來表示「糟糕的」或「極其」，但在閱讀測驗中，常出現在描述情緒、氣候或品質極差的情境中。學生應注意它在否定句中可能作為強烈地修飾語，而非單純地表示「壞」。","senses":[{"sense":"糟糕的；可怕的（品質、感受或情況極差）","entries":[{"pattern":"awful","pos":"adjective","translation":"糟糕的；可怕的","explanation":"用來修飾名詞，描述事物品質極低或令人不快。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the heavy rain, the old garbage bins outside the school began to smell <target>awful</target>, bothering everyone nearby.","translation":"大雨後，學校外的舊垃圾桶開始散發出糟糕的氣味，困擾著附近的所有人。"},{"sentence":"I felt <target>awful</target> about forgetting my best friend's birthday, so I bought her a large cake to apologize.","translation":"對於忘記好朋友的生日，我感到非常糟糕，所以我買了一個大蛋糕向她道歉。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"terrible","pos":"adjective","translation":"可怕的；糟糕的","explanation":"與 awful 幾乎完全相同，指品質極差"},{"word":"horrible","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人厭惡的；可怕的","explanation":"強調令人反感或恐懼"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"wonderful","pos":"adjective","translation":"絕佳的；美妙的","explanation":"指品質或感受極好"},{"word":"excellent","pos":"adjective","translation":"translation\": ","explanation":null},{"word":"excellent","pos":"adjective","translation":"極好的；卓越的","explanation":"強調最高品質"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awfully","pos":"adverb","translation":"糟糕地；非常","explanation":"可用作強調副詞，等同於 very"}]}}

{"headword":"awkward","explanation":"「awkward」是一個描述人際關係或身體動作的關鍵形容詞。它在學測中常出現在兩種情境：一是描述身體上的「笨拙」；二是描述社交情境中的「尷尬」或「不自然」。學生應能快速辨識這兩種細微的區意。","senses":[{"sense":"尷尬的；不自然的（社交情境中令人不適的感覺）","entries":[{"pattern":"awkward","pos":"adjective","translation":"尷尬的；不自然的","explanation":"描述人與人之間缺乏對話或缺乏默契時產生的不適感。","sentences":[{"sentence":"There was an <target>awkward</target> silence in the classroom after the teacher asked a difficult question and nobody answered.","translation":"在老師問了一個困難的問題且沒有人回答後，教室裡出現了一陣尷尬的沉默。"},{"sentence":"I felt <target>awkward</target> when I accidentally called my teacher by the wrong name during the class presentation.","translation":"當我在課堂報告時不小心把老師叫錯名字，我感到非常尷尬。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"embarrassing","pos":"adjective","translation":"令人尷尬的","explanation":"強調外在事物導致的尷尬感"},{"word":"uncomfortable","pos":"adjective","translation":"不舒服的；不自在的","explanation":"泛指心理或生理上的不適"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"natural","pos":"adjective","translation":"自然的","explanation":"指動作或對話流暢不僵硬"}]},{"sense":"笨拙的；難以處理的（動作不流暢或位置不便）","entries":[{"pattern":"awkward","pos":"adjective","translation":"笨拙的；難以處理的","explanation":"描述肢體動作不靈活，或物品的位置讓操作起來很困難。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The puppy was still learning how to walk and often made <target>awkward</target> movements with its short legs.","translation":"小狗還在學習如何行走，經常在短腿上做出笨拙的動作。"},{"sentence":"It is <target>awkward</target> to carry these heavy boxes to the third floor without using an elevator.","translation":"不用電梯將這些沉重的箱子搬到三樓是非常困難且不便的。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"clumsy","pos":"adjective","translation":"笨拙的","explanation":"指肢體動作不靈活"},{"word":"unwieldy","pos":"adjective","translation":"笨重且難以操作的","explanation":"指物品體積大或形狀不規則而難以搬運"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"graceful","pos":"adjective","translation":"優雅的；流暢的","explanation":"指動作非常自然且靈活"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[{"word":"awkwardly","pos":"adverb","translation":"尷尬地；笨拙地","explanation":"由形容詞 awkward 加上副詞字尾 -ly 構成。"}]}}

{"headword":"background","explanation":"「background」在學測中具有多重語意。它可以用於描述視覺上的「背景」，也可以用於描述一個人的「背景」或「經歷」。學生應根據上下文（如教育背景或家庭背景）來判斷其具體含義。","senses":[{"sense":"背景（視覺上的後方空間）","entries":[{"pattern":"in the background","pos":"phrase","translation":"在背景中","explanation":"描述在照片、繪畫或場景中位於後方、較不顯眼的部位。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you look closely at the old photograph, you can see a small house <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>background</target> of the picture.","translation":"如果你仔細看那張舊照片，你可以看到照片背景中有一間小房子。"},{"sentence":"The singer performed her song while a beautiful landscape of mountains and clouds was shown <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>background</target>.","translation":"這位歌手在演唱歌曲時，背景中顯示著一座山脈與雲海的美麗風景。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"setting","pos":"noun","translation":"環境；背景","explanation":"指故事或事件發生的環境"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"foreground","pos":"noun","translation":"前景","explanation":"指在視覺上最前方、最顯眼的部分"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 back (後方) + ground (地面/基礎)","related":[{"word":"backgrounder","pos":"noun","translation":"背景資料","explanation":"提供關於某事詳細背景資訊的說明文件。"}]}}

{"headword":"cock","explanation":"「cock」在學測中較少作為核心考點，但出現在閱讀中時，通常指代雄雞或特定的機械裝置（如水龍頭的閥門）。在現代英語中，需注意其在非正式口語中可能具有俚語含義，因此在正式寫作中建議謹慎使用。","senses":[{"sense":"公雞；雄雞","entries":[{"pattern":"cock","pos":"noun","translation":"公雞","explanation":"指雄性的雞。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Every morning at five o'clock, the loud <target>cock</target> in the backyard woke up the entire village with its piercing cry.","translation":"每天早上五點，後院那隻大聲的公雞用它尖銳的叫聲喚醒了整個村莊。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"rooster","pos":"noun","translation":"公雞","explanation":"美式英語中更常用的詞彙"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"閥門；水龍頭（機械結構）","entries":[{"pattern":"stopcock","pos":"noun","translation":"止水閥","explanation":"雖然是複合詞，但其核心根源在於 cock (閥門) 的意象。","sentences":[{"sentence":"When the pipe burst, the plumber quickly turned the stop<target>cock</target> to stop the water from flooding the kitchen floor.","translation":"當水管破裂時，水管工快速轉動止水閥，以防止水淹沒廚房地板。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cocktail","explanation":"「cocktail」最基礎的含義是混合飲料，但在學測的環境、社會類文章中，常被用作比喻，指代「各種事物的混合體」。理解這個比喻義是提升閱讀理解力的關鍵。","senses":[{"sense":"調酒；混合飲料","entries":[{"pattern":"cocktail","pos":"noun","translation":"調酒","explanation":"由酒精與其他成分混合而成的飲料。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The hotel bar offered a wide variety of colorful <target>cocktails</target>, blending fresh fruit juices with different kinds of spirits.","translation":"酒店酒吧提供多種色彩繽紛的調酒，將新鮮水果汁與不同種類的烈酒混合。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"混合物（比喻義：各種成分的組合）","entries":[{"pattern":"a cocktail of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"一種…的混合物","explanation":"用來描述一種複雜的、通常是負面或強烈的情緒或因素的組合。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sudden economic crisis created a dangerous <target>cocktail</target> <pattern>of</pattern> unemployment, inflation and social unrest among the young people.","translation":"突然的經濟危機造成了一種由失業、通貨膨脹與社會動盪構成的危險混合物（綜合影響）。"},{"sentence":"The patient's recovery was slow because the doctor gave her a powerful <target>cocktail</target> <pattern>of</pattern> strong medicines to fight the infection.","translation":"患者的康復過程緩慢，因為醫生給她一種由強效藥物組成的強力混合藥劑（組合）以對抗感染。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"mixture","pos":"noun","translation":"混合物","explanation":"最普遍的通用詞"},{"word":"blend","pos":"noun","translation":"融合","explanation":"強調成分之間協調一致"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"coconut","explanation":"「coconut」在生物、自然生態類閱讀中是基礎名詞。其用法簡單，重點在於其產地（熱帶地區）與其產出的產品（油、水、肉）的描述。","senses":[{"sense":"椰子","entries":[{"pattern":"coconut","pos":"noun","translation":"椰子","explanation":"指一種熱帶棕櫚樹的果實。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While walking along the tropical beach, the tourists were warned not to stand under the palm trees because <target>coconuts</target> might fall.","translation":"在熱帶海邊行走時， tourist 被警告不要站在棕櫚樹下，因為椰子可能會掉下來。"},{"sentence":"Many people in Southeast Asia use <target>coconut</target> oil as a natural ingredient for cooking and skin care products.","translation":"東南亞許多人將椰子油作為烹飪和皮膚護理產品的天然成分。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"collar","explanation":"「collar」在學測中主要出現於兩種語境：一是服裝的「衣領」，二是動物的「項圈」。此外，在新聞閱讀中，常出現 a white-collar / blue-collar worker 這種職業類別的描述，這是極高頻的考點。","senses":[{"sense":"衣領；項圈","entries":[{"pattern":"collar","pos":"noun","translation":"衣領；項圈","explanation":"指衣服上圍繞脖子的部分，或動物佩戴的項圈。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The student wore a crisp white shirt with a stiff <target>collar</target> for his first official job interview at the bank.","translation":"這名學生為了在銀行進行第一次正式的工作面試，穿了一件領口僵硬的純白襯衫。"},{"sentence":"The lost dog was finally found by a kind neighbor, who noticed the address and phone number on its leather <target>collar</target>.","translation":"那隻失蹤的狗最終被一位好心的鄰居發現，對方注意到了它皮革項圈上的地址和電話號碼。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"白領/藍領（職業類別）","entries":[{"pattern":"white-collar / blue-collar","pos":"phrase","translation":"白領／藍領","explanation":"用來區分辦公室專業人員（white-collar）與體力勞動者（blue-collar）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In the past, <target>white-collar</target> workers spent most of their time typing on computers, while <pattern>blue-collar</pattern> workers worked in factories.","translation":"在過去，白領工人花大部分時間在電腦上打字，而藍領工人則在工廠中工作。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to reduce the gap between <target>white-collar</target> employees and <pattern>blue-collar</pattern> laborers to ensure social fairness.","translation":"政府正試圖縮小白領員工與藍領勞動者之間的差距，以確保社會公平。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"complain","explanation":"「complain」在學測中常用於描述不滿、投訴或對生活品質的抗議。學習時需注意它與名詞 complaint 的區分，以及其後接續的介系詞搭配（about, of, to），這是克漏字與文意選填的常見考點。","senses":[{"sense":"抱怨；投訴（表達不滿）","entries":[{"pattern":"complain about sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"抱怨某事","explanation":"最普遍的用法，指對某個狀況、環境或服務不滿而表達出來的抱怨。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many students often <target>complain</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the heavy amount of homework their teachers give them every single weekend.","translation":"許多學生經常抱怨老師每個週末給他們的作業量過重。"},{"sentence":"The local residents began to <target>complain</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the loud noise coming from the construction site next to their houses.","translation":"當地居民開始抱怨鄰近房屋的建築工地傳來的巨大噪音。"}]},{"pattern":"complain to sb. about sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"向某人抱怨某事","explanation":"明確指出投訴的對象（to sb.）以及抱怨的內容（about sth.）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"If you are not happy with the food in the cafeteria, you should <target>complain</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the manager <pattern>about</pattern> the quality.","translation":"如果你對食堂的食物不滿意，你應該向經理投訴其品質。"}]},{"pattern":"complain that...","pos":"phrase","translation":"抱怨說…","explanation":"後接名詞子句，用來具體敘述抱怨的內容，常用於小說或閱讀測驗的對話中。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Some passengers <target>complained</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the air conditioning in the bus was not working properly during the hot summer day.","translation":"一些乘客抱怨說，在炎熱的夏日裡，巴士上的冷氣設備無法正常運作。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grumble","pos":"verb","translation":"發牢騷；嘟囔","explanation":"強調低聲地、不滿地表達抱怨"},{"word":"protest","pos":"verb","translation":"抗議；反對","explanation":"語氣較強，指公開且正式地表達不滿"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"praise","pos":"verb","translation":"稱讚；讚美","explanation":"表達滿意與認可"}]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"complained","past_participle":"complained"},"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 complain (抱怨) + 名詞字尾 -t","related":[{"word":"complaint","pos":"noun","translation":"投訴；抱怨","explanation":"由動詞 complain 轉變而來，指代抱怨的內容或正式的投訴書。"}]}}

{"headword":"complaint","explanation":"「complaint」是名詞形式，常出現在正式的商務書信或客訴處理情境中。學生應注意它與動詞 complain 的區分，以及它常搭配的動詞如 make a complaint 或 file a complaint。","senses":[{"sense":"投訴；抱怨（名詞形式）","entries":[{"pattern":"make a complaint","pos":"phrase","translation":"提出投訴","explanation":"最常用的口語表達方式，指表達不滿並請求解決。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After waiting for an hour without any answer, the customer decided to <pattern>make</pattern> a <target>complaint</target> to the store manager.","translation":"在等待一小時沒有任何答覆後，顧客決定向店經理提出投訴。"}]},{"pattern":"file a complaint","pos":"phrase","translation":"正式提出投訴；提交投訴書","explanation":"語氣更正式，通常指透過法律或官方渠道提交正式文書。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company was forced to improve its safety rules after many workers <pattern>filed</pattern> a formal <target>complaint</target> against the dangerous environment.","translation":"在許多工人針對危險環境提交正式投訴後，公司被迫改善其安全規則。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"grievance","pos":"noun","translation":"不滿；委屈","explanation":"指對不公平對待的深層不滿"},{"word":"objection","pos":"noun","translation":"反對；異議","explanation":"指對某事不贊同的意見"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 complain (抱怨) + 名詞字尾 -t","related":[{"word":"complain","pos":"verb","translation":"抱怨；投訴","explanation":"對應的動詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"conscious","explanation":"「conscious」在學測中常與 be conscious of sth. 搭配，表示「意識到」。要注意它與 subconscious (潛意識) 及 subconsciousness (潛意識狀態) 的區別。","senses":[{"sense":"有意識的；覺醒的（指精神上清醒或意識到某事）","entries":[{"pattern":"be conscious of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"意識到某事","explanation":"最常見的搭配，指察覺到環境、他人看法或自身狀態。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because she was <target>conscious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the impact of plastic waste, she decided to stop using plastic bags.","translation":"因為她意識到塑料廢棄物的影響，她決定停止使用塑料袋。"},{"sentence":"The boy became <target>conscious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the silence in the room when he realized that everyone was looking at him.","translation":"當男孩意識到每個人都在看他時，他察覺到了房間裡的寂靜。"}]},{"pattern":"conscious effort","pos":"phrase","translation":"有意識的努力","explanation":"名詞修飾，指刻意地去做某事，而非出於本能或習慣。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Learning a new language requires a <target>conscious</target> effort to practice speaking and listening every single day.","translation":"學習一種新語言需要有意識的努力，每天練習說話和聆聽。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"aware","pos":"adjective","translation":"意識到的；察覺的","explanation":"最普遍的同義詞，指察覺到某事的存在"},{"word":"mindful","pos":"adjective","translation":"留心的；注意的","explanation":"強調刻意地將注意力集中在某事上"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"unconscious","pos":"adjective","translation":"無意識的；昏迷的","explanation":"指精神上不清醒或在潛意識中行動"}]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 consci- (知道) + -ous (形容詞字尾)","related":[{"word":"consciously","pos":"adverb","translation":"有意識地","explanation":"由形容詞 conscious 加上副詞字尾 -ly 延伸而來。"},{"word":"consciousness","pos":"noun","translation":"意識；覺醒","explanation":"由形容詞 conscious 加上名詞字尾 -ness 延伸而來。"}]}}
