{"headword":"continent","explanation":"「continent」在地理、環境或歷史類閱讀中是基礎詞彙。學生需區分其作為名詞指代「大陸/洲」的用法，以及在極少數情境中與 an ocean 對比的地理分佈。","senses":[{"sense":"大陸；洲（地球表面巨大的陸地塊）","entries":[{"pattern":"the African / Asian continent","pos":"phrase","translation":"非洲洲／亞洲大陸","explanation":"常用於描述特定洲份的地理特徵、野生動物分佈或文化差異。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Many unique species of animals, such as kangaroos and koalas, are only found on the Australian <target>continent</target>.","translation":"許多獨特的動物物種，如袋鼠和無尾熊，僅在澳洲大陸上被發現。"},{"sentence":"The professor explained how the seven <target>continents</target> were once a single giant landmass called Pangaea millions of years ago.","translation":"教授解釋了數百萬年前，這七個大洲曾經是一個被稱為盤古大陸的單一巨型陸地。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"來自拉丁語 continere (包含、圍繞)","related":[{"word":"continental","pos":"adjective","translation":"大陸的；洲的","explanation":"形容詞形式，常用於 continental breakfast (歐陸式早餐)。"}]}}

{"headword":"controller","explanation":"「controller」在科技、電子產品或管理情境中非常高頻。它可以指硬體設備（如遊戲控制器）或指職位（如財務控制員）。","senses":[{"sense":"控制器；遙控器（用來操作設備的硬體）","entries":[{"pattern":"game controller","pos":"phrase","translation":"遊戲控制器","explanation":"指用來操作電子遊戲的手把或遙控設備。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young boy was so excited that he accidentally dropped his <target>controller</target> on the floor while playing a racing game.","translation":"那個小男孩太興奮了，在玩賽車遊戲時不小心把他的控制器掉在地上。"}]},{"pattern":"remote controller","pos":"phrase","translation":"遙控器","explanation":"指用來遠端操作電器設備的裝置。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My father spent ten minutes searching for the TV <target>controller</target> only to find it hidden under the living room sofa.","translation":"我父親花十分鐘尋找電視遙控器，結果發現它就藏在客廳沙發底下。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"控制者；管理員（負責監督或管理某事的人）","entries":[{"pattern":"financial controller","pos":"phrase","translation":"財務控制員","explanation":"指公司內部負責監督財務預算與成本的專業人員。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The company hired a professional <target>controller</target> to manage the budget and ensure that no money was wasted on useless projects.","translation":"公司聘請了一位專業的財務控制員來管理預算，並確保沒有資金被浪費在無用的專案上。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"manager","pos":"noun","translation":"經理；管理員","explanation":"泛指管理的人"},{"word":"supervisor","pos":"noun","translation":"主管；監督者","explanation":"強調監督工作過程"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 control (控制) + 名詞字尾 -ler (人或物)","related":[{"word":"control","pos":"verb","translation":"控制；管理","explanation":"核心基礎動詞。"},{"word":"controllable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可控制的","explanation":"形容詞形式。"}]}}

{"headword":"cooker","explanation":"「cooker」與「cook」在學測中是極易混淆的考點。cook 指的是「廚師」(n.) 或「烹飪」(v.)，而 cooker 則是指「烹飪設備/電鍋/爐灶」(n.)。學生必須在填空題中根據其物理性質（人 vs 物）來區分。","senses":[{"sense":"烹飪設備；爐灶；電鍋（用來煮東西的器具）","entries":[{"pattern":"electric cooker / pressure cooker","pos":"phrase","translation":"電爐／壓力鍋","explanation":"指具體的烹飪器具。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My mother bought a new pressure <target>cooker</target> that can cook tough meat in half the time it usually takes.","translation":"我母親買了一個新的壓力鍋，可以在一半的時間內將堅硬的肉煮熟。"},{"sentence":"Please be careful when using the electric <target>cooker</target> in the dorm, as it may cause a fire if left unattended.","translation":"在宿舍使用電爐時請小心，因為如果沒人看管，可能會引起火災。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"動詞 cook (煮) + 名詞字尾 -er (物)","related":[{"word":"cook","pos":"noun","translation":"廚師","explanation":"指烹飪的人。"}]}}

{"headword":"costly","explanation":"「costly」在學測中作為形容詞，表示「昂貴的」或「代價慘重的」。除了指金錢上的昂貴，它在閱讀測驗中常被用來描述一個錯誤或決定導致的嚴重後果（代價慘重）。","senses":[{"sense":"昂貴的（價格高）","entries":[{"pattern":"costly jewelry / equipment","pos":"phrase","translation":"昂貴的珠寶／設備","explanation":"等同於 expensive，但語氣更正式。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Building a high-speed railway system is a <target>costly</target> project that requires billions of dollars in government funding.","translation":"建造高鐵系統是一個昂貴的專案，需要政府投入數十億美元的資金。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"expensive","pos":"adjective","translation":"昂貴的","explanation":"最普遍的用法"},{"word":"pricey","pos":"adjective","translation":"價格高的","explanation":"口語化用法"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"cheap","pos":"adjective","translation":"便宜的","explanation":"指價格低"},{"word":"inexpensive","pos":"adjective","translation":"不昂貴的","explanation":"較正式的用法"}]},{"sense":"代價慘重的（導致嚴重後果）","entries":[{"pattern":"a costly mistake / error","pos":"phrase","translation":"慘重的錯誤／失誤","explanation":"指一個決定或錯誤導致了巨大的損失（金錢、時間或機會）。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The team's failure to check the weather report before the trip was a <target>costly</target> <pattern>mistake</pattern> that led to their rescue.","translation":"該團隊在出發前未能檢查氣象報告是一個慘重的失誤，導致他們必須被救援。"},{"sentence":"Forgetting to save the file before the computer crashed was a <target>costly</target> <pattern>error</pattern> that cost the student hours of hard work.","translation":"在電腦當機前忘記儲存檔案是一個慘重的錯誤，導致學生損失了數小時的辛苦工作。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"dear","pos":"adjective","translation":"親愛的；昂貴的","explanation":"在英國英語中，costly 常用於指價格昂貴"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"名詞 cost (成本) + 形容詞字尾 -ly","related":[{"word":"cost","pos":"noun","translation":"成本；費用","explanation":"核心基礎名詞。"}]}}

{"headword":"cotton","explanation":"「cotton」在學測中常出現在探討紡織工業、環保面料或植物生態的閱讀文章中。除了指植物本身，更常作為名詞修飾名詞（noun adjunct），用來描述衣物的材質。","senses":[{"sense":"棉花；棉織品（植物及其纖維製成的布料）","entries":[{"pattern":"cotton","pos":"noun","translation":"棉花","explanation":"指植物本身或其纖維。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Farmers in the south grow a vast amount of <target>cotton</target> to sell to clothing factories around the world.","translation":"南方的農民種植大量棉花以賣給全世界的服裝工廠。"}]},{"pattern":"cotton clothes / a cotton shirt","pos":"phrase","translation":"棉質衣服／棉質襯衫","explanation":"使用 cotton 作為形容詞性質的修飾語，描述衣物的材質。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because <target>cotton</target> clothes are breathable and soft, many people prefer to wear them during the hot summer months.","translation":"因為棉質衣服透氣且柔軟，許多人偏好在炎熱的夏季月份穿著它們。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"棉球（醫療用）","entries":[{"pattern":"cotton ball","pos":"noun","translation":"醫療棉球","explanation":"指用於清潔傷口或化妝的圓形棉球。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The nurse gently used a small <target>cotton</target> ball to clean the blood and dirt away from the patient's cut.","translation":"護理師輕輕地使用一個小棉球將病人傷口上的血液與污垢清理掉。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cough","explanation":"「cough」在健康與生理描述中是基礎詞彙。需注意其作為動詞時的用法，以及在名詞形式下常搭配的形容詞（如 dry, productive）來描述症狀。","senses":[{"sense":"咳嗽（生理反應）","entries":[{"pattern":"cough","pos":"verb","translation":"咳嗽","explanation":"不及物動詞，描述身體不由自主地排出空氣的動作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The young boy started to <target>cough</target> violently after he accidentally breathed in some smoke from the campfire.","translation":"那個小男孩在不小心吸入營火的一些煙霧後，開始劇烈地咳嗽。"}]},{"pattern":"have a cough","pos":"phrase","translation":"咳嗽；患有咳嗽症狀","explanation":"名詞用法，常搭配 have 或 suffer from。","sentences":[{"sentence":"My little sister has had a terrible <target>cough</target> for over a week, so my parents took her to the doctor.","translation":"我的妹妹咳嗽得很厲害，已經持續一個多星期了，所以我的父母帶她去看醫生。"}]},{"pattern":"cough up sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"咳出某物／（非正式）拿出錢","explanation":"片語用法。字面意思是咳出痰或異物，引申為勉強地拿出錢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sick dog <target>coughed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> some thick mucus from its lungs to clear its breathing passage.","translation":"那隻生病的狗從肺部咳出了一些濃痰，以清理其呼吸道。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"coughed","past_participle":"coughed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"countable","explanation":"「countable」在數學、語言學或基礎英文文法討論中出現。其核心含義在於「可計數的」，與 uncountable 或 infinite 對立。","senses":[{"sense":"可計數的（可以用數字直接量化）","entries":[{"pattern":"countable noun","pos":"phrase","translation":"可數名詞","explanation":"最常見的搭配，用於文法教學或語言分析。","sentences":[{"sentence":"In English grammar, a <target>countable</target> noun refers to things that can be counted as individual units, such as books or apples.","translation":"在英文文法中，可數名詞是指可以作為個別單元計算的事物，例如書籍或蘋果。"}]},{"pattern":"countable","pos":"adjective","translation":"可數的；可計數的","explanation":"泛指任何可以用數字量化的事物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The total cost of the project was <target>countable</target>, but the amount of happiness it brought us was truly infinite.","translation":"這個專案的總成本是可計數的，但它帶給我們的快樂則是真正無限的。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":"字根 count (計數) + 形容詞字尾 -able (能夠...的)","related":[{"word":"count","pos":"noun","translation":"數量；計算","explanation":"基礎動詞/名詞型態。"},{"word":"uncountable","pos":"adjective","translation":"不可數的","explanation":"由 countable 加上否定字首 un- 延伸而來。"}]}}

{"headword":"county","explanation":"「county」常出現在描述美國或英國等英語國家行政區劃的文章中。學生常將其與 country (國家) 混淆，需強調其行政區劃的層級（通常在州或省之下）。","senses":[{"sense":"郡；縣（行政區劃）","entries":[{"pattern":"county","pos":"noun","translation":"郡；縣","explanation":"指一個特定的行政管理區域。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The local <target>county</target> government decided to build a new library to provide more resources for the students in the area.","translation":"當地郡政府決定建造一座新圖書館，以提供該地區學生更多資源。"}]},{"pattern":"county road / county park","pos":"phrase","translation":"郡道／郡立公園","explanation":"名詞修飾名詞，指由該郡政府管轄的設施。","sentences":[{"sentence":"We drove along the quiet <target>county</target> road for an hour before we finally reached the small village in the mountains.","translation":"我們沿著安靜的郡道開了一小時車，最後才到達山區的小村莊。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"crab","explanation":"「crab」在自然生態或海洋生物類閱讀測驗中是基礎名詞。重點在於其生物特徵的描述以及相關的慣用語。","senses":[{"sense":"螃蟹（甲殼類動物）","entries":[{"pattern":"crab","pos":"noun","translation":"螃蟹","explanation":"指海洋或淡水中的甲殼類動物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"While walking along the beach, the children found a small <target>crab</target> hiding under a wet rock near the water.","translation":"在海邊散步時，孩子們在水邊的一塊濕岩石下發現了一隻小螃蟹。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":null,"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"cradle","explanation":"「cradle」在學測中兼具具體與抽象含義。名詞時指嬰兒的搖籃，動詞時則常用於描述某種文化、思想或文明的「發源地」或「孕育」過程。在閱讀測驗中，看到此字常與早期人類文明或嬰兒照顧相關。","senses":[{"sense":"搖籃（嬰兒睡覺的床）","entries":[{"pattern":"cradle","pos":"noun","translation":"搖籃","explanation":"指供嬰兒睡眠的特製小床，通常可以搖動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The tired mother gently rocked the wooden <target>cradle</target> back and forth to help her newborn baby fall asleep.","translation":"疲憊的母親輕輕地前後搖動木製搖籃，好讓她的新生兒入睡。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"bassinet","pos":"noun","translation":"嬰兒籃","explanation":"一種較小且可移動的嬰兒床"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"發源地；搖籃（比喻某事開始或發展的地方）","entries":[{"pattern":"the cradle of sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"…的發源地","explanation":"比喻某個重要文明、藝術或思想最初誕生並成長的地方。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Mesopotamia is often called the <target>cradle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> civilization because early humans first built cities and developed writing there.","translation":"美索不達米亞常被稱為文明的發源地，因為早期人類首先在那裡建造城市並發展出文字。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"birthplace","pos":"noun","translation":"出生地；發源地","explanation":"最直接的同義詞，指事物開始的地方"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"抱在懷中；支撐（用手臂或手托住）","entries":[{"pattern":"cradle sth./sb. in one's arms","pos":"phrase","translation":"將…抱在懷中","explanation":"強調像搖籃一樣溫柔地托住或抱著某人或某物。","sentences":[{"sentence":"After the long race, the runner collapsed in pain, and his teammate <target>cradled</target> him <pattern>in</pattern> his arms to keep him safe.","translation":"長跑賽後，那名跑者因疼痛而倒下，而他的隊友將他抱在懷中以確保他的安全。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hold","pos":"verb","translation":"抱著；持有","explanation":"通用詞，指用手或手臂持有"},{"word":"nurture","pos":"verb","translation":"養育；培育","explanation":"比喻將某人像在搖籃中一樣照顧"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"cradled","past_participle":"cradled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"crane","explanation":"「crane」在學測中是一個典型的多義字。名詞時可指生物學上的「鶴」或工業上的「起重機」，動詞時則描述一種特定的身體動作（伸長脖子）。學生需根據上下文，判斷該物體是否具有「生物屬性」或「機械屬性」。","senses":[{"sense":"起重機（大型吊車）","entries":[{"pattern":"crane","pos":"noun","translation":"起重機；吊車","explanation":"指用於建築工地或港口搬運沉重物體的大型機械。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The construction workers used a giant <target>crane</target> to lift the heavy steel beams and place them precisely on the roof.","translation":"建築工人使用一台巨大的起重機將沉重的鋼樑吊起，並精確地將其放置在屋頂上。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"hoist","pos":"noun","translation":"起重裝置","explanation":"較專業的吊裝設備名稱"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"鶴（一種長頸長腿的鳥類）","entries":[{"pattern":"crane","pos":"noun","translation":"鶴","explanation":"指一種優雅的、長頸長腿的大型鳥類，常用於自然生態描寫。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The wildlife photographer spent three days in the cold marshes, hoping to capture a beautiful photo of a dancing <target>crane</target>.","translation":"野生動物攝影師在寒冷的沼澤中待了三天，希望能拍到一張舞鶴優雅舞蹈的照片。"}]}],"synonyms":[],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"伸長脖子（為了看清某物）","entries":[{"pattern":"crane one's neck","pos":"phrase","translation":"伸長脖子","explanation":"模仿鶴的脖子，指為了看清前方或上方而用力伸長脖子。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The short boy had to <target>crane</target> his <pattern>neck</pattern> to see the famous singer performing on the high stage.","translation":"那個矮小的男孩不得不伸長脖子，才能看見在高台上表演的著名歌手。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"stretch","pos":"verb","translation":"伸展；伸長","explanation":"泛指身體部位的伸展"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"craned","past_participle":"craned"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"crash","explanation":"「crash」的用法非常多元，涵蓋了物理上的碰撞、聲音上的劇烈撞擊，以及科技上的系統當機。在學測中，重點在於區分這三種完全不同的情境（交通、聲響、資訊科技）。","senses":[{"sense":"碰撞；毀滅（劇烈地撞擊）","entries":[{"pattern":"crash into sth.","pos":"phrase","translation":"撞上某物","explanation":"指車輛、飛機或物體以高速撞擊到另一個物體。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because the driver fell asleep at the wheel, the car <target>crashed</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a large tree by the side of the road.","translation":"因為駕駛在方向盤前睡著了，車子撞上了一棵路邊的大樹。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"collide","pos":"verb","translation":"碰撞","explanation":"指兩個移動物體互相撞擊"},{"word":"smash","pos":"verb","translation":"粉碎；猛撞","explanation":"強調撞擊後物體破碎的結果"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"崩潰；當機（電腦或系統失效）","entries":[{"pattern":"crash","pos":"verb","translation":"當機；崩潰","explanation":"資訊科技術語，指電腦系統或軟體突然停止運作。","sentences":[{"sentence":"I was almost finished with my history essay, but my computer <target>crashed</target>, and I lost all the information I had written.","translation":"我的歷史論文快要寫完了，但我的電腦突然當機，導致我寫的所有資訊都遺失了。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"fail","pos":"verb","translation":"失效；故障","explanation":"泛指系統無法運作"}],"antonyms":[]},{"sense":"劇烈撞擊聲；崩潰（名詞用法）","entries":[{"pattern":"a crash","pos":"noun","translation":"撞擊聲；碰撞事故","explanation":"指碰撞時發出的巨大聲響，或指一次碰撞事故。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The sudden <target>crash</target> of plates breaking in the kitchen scared the cat, making it jump high into the air.","translation":"廚房裡盤子破碎的突然撞擊聲嚇到了貓，讓它高高地跳向空中。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"bang","pos":"noun","translation":"砰的一聲；巨響","explanation":"指突然且巨大的聲音"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"crashed","past_participle":"crashed"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}

{"headword":"crawl","explanation":"「crawl」除了指動物或嬰兒的爬行外，在現代英語中也常用於描述交通緩慢或網路速度極慢（如 crawl along）。在閱讀中，看到此字應首先考慮其動作特徵：緩慢且身體貼近地面。","senses":[{"sense":"爬行（身體貼近地面移動）","entries":[{"pattern":"crawl","pos":"verb","translation":"爬行","explanation":"指嬰兒、昆蟲或受傷的人用手腳在地面移動。","sentences":[{"sentence":"The baby is not yet able to walk, so he spends most of his time <target>crawling</target> across the living room floor.","translation":"這個嬰兒還不會走路，所以他大部分的時間都在客廳地板上爬行。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"creep","pos":"verb","translation":"悄悄爬行；潛行","explanation":"強調緩慢且為了不被發現而移動"}],"antonyms":[{"word":"run","pos":"verb","translation":"奔跑","explanation":"指快速移動"}]},{"sense":"緩慢移動（比喻交通或速度極慢）","entries":[{"pattern":"crawl along","pos":"phrase","translation":"緩慢前進","explanation":"用來描述交通堵塞時車輛前進的速度極慢。","sentences":[{"sentence":"Because of the heavy rain and a car accident, the traffic on the highway <target>crawled</target> <pattern>along</pattern> at a very slow pace.","translation":"因為大雨和一場車禍，高速公路上的交通緩慢前進，速度非常慢。"}]}],"synonyms":[{"word":"drag","pos":"verb","translation":"拖延；緩慢移動","explanation":"指速度極慢，像在拖行一樣"}],"antonyms":[]}],"conjugations":{"past_tense":"crawled","past_participle":"crawled"},"relatives":{"morphology":null,"related":[]}}
